games.name: A Link Between Worlds
games.summary: Sequel spirituel d'A Link to the Past sur 3DS. Link peut se transformer en tableau pour parcourir les murs. Nouveau mécanisme de location d'équipement et monde miroir d'Hyrule: Lorule.
games.description: Link can merge into walls as a 2D painting in this direct sequel to A Link to the Past, set in Hyrule and the mirrored kingdom of Lorule. A rental system lets players borrow items freely, allowing dungeons to be tackled in any order — a bold design that rewards exploration and experimentation.

games.name: A Link to the Past
games.summary: Considéré comme l'un des meilleurs jeux de tous les temps. Link doit rassembler les 7 Cristaux de Sagesse pour vaincre Ganon et sauver Hyrule. Intro introduce la vision issométrique classique.
games.description: The definitive 2D Zelda experience on SNES. Link traverses both the Light and Dark Worlds to collect the Seven Crystals and defeat Ganon. Introduced the Master Sword, the Dark World mechanic, and the top-down formula that defined the series for an entire generation.

games.name: Abzû
games.summary: Jeu d'exploration sous-marine contemplatif développé par Giant Squid. Le joueur incarne un plongeur qui nage parmi des milliers de poissons et créatures marines dans des environnements magnifiques.
games.description: A wordless underwater journey through a breathtaking ocean world teeming with life. Dive alongside thousands of fish, interact with ancient ruins, and piece together a mysterious story told entirely through environmental storytelling and stunning visuals. A meditative, short but unforgettable experience.

games.name: Airwolf
games.summary: Airwolf was loosely based on the television series of the same name, and involves the player completing a series of rescue missions. The beginning of the game involves the player being called back into duty after retirement. The game contains thirty missions, each with the objective being to rescue prisoners being held captive in enemy bases. The layout of each mission changes as the player progresses.
games.description: Airwolf was originally designed as an Arcade game, based loosely on the television series of the same name. It was later released for the Nintendo Entertainment System.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). MobyGames critics: 38% avg (9 reviews). Generally considered a mediocre TV tie-in.

games.name: Andro Dunos II
games.summary: Once upon a time… Andro Dunos is a side scrolling arcade game from shoot’em up category (Shmup). It's the sequel to the famous shoot’em up from Visco studio is coming to PixelHeart. It’s time to bring out your good old spaceship fighter in Andro Dunos II.
games.description: A modern horizontal shoot 'em up sequel to the classic Neo Geo arcade game. Andro Dunos II features four weapon types switchable on the fly, intense bullet-hell action across multiple worlds, and a retro aesthetic with HD visuals. Designed for fans of classic arcade shmups.

games.name: ARMS
games.summary: ARMS, a mix of boxing and shooting where you use extendable arms to battle your friends both locally and online! Take a Joy-Con in each hand and punch forward, twisting your fists to bend your attacks.  "Choose a fighting champion from around the world, equip your own combination of extendable arms, and then use a mix of button presses and quick hand motions to really take the fight to your opponent. Throw punches and guide them midflight to hit agile fighters, avoid incoming attacks with dashes, or trampoline high into the air to rain down fists from above. Power-up your punches to deal extra damage or curve your fists around obstacles to hit skittish opponents. Fill up your special gauge to dish out devastating combinations and finish them off. Unleash your inner fighter in this unbelievable sporting event! "
games.description: A unique fighting game from Nintendo where fighters use extendable spring-loaded arms to punch at range. Choose from a diverse cast, customize arm loadouts, and battle across Grand Prix, single-player, local, and online modes. Features a bright, colorful art style with surprisingly deep competitive mechanics.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Origins
games.summary: Assassin's Creed dans l'Égypte ancienne. Bayek, médjay, venge son fils et jette les bases de l'ordre des Assassins. Open-world immense avec pyramides, désert et Nil. Origins du RPG dans la série.
games.description: Set in ancient Egypt, Origins follows Bayek, a Medjay warrior, as he uncovers the conspiracy behind his son's murder and inadvertently founds the Brotherhood of Assassins. The game reimagined the AC series with a full action RPG structure, level-based progression, and a vast open world spanning pyramids, deserts, and the Nile delta.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Syndicate
games.summary: Assassin's Creed dans le Londres victorien de 1868. Les jumeaux Evie et Jacob Frye unissent leurs compétences pour libérer la ville de l'emprise des Templiers. Parkour urbain et gadgets steampunk.
games.description: Set in Victorian London of 1868, twins Evie and Jacob Frye fight to liberate the city from Templar control through parkour, combat, and steampunk gadgets. The first Assassin's Creed with two playable protagonists, each with distinct playstyles — Evie specializes in stealth and artifacts, Jacob in brawling and gang warfare.

games.name: Back 4 Blood: Deluxe Edition
games.summary: Back 4 Blood is a thrilling cooperative first-person shooter from the creators of the critically acclaimed Left 4 Dead franchise. Experience the intense 4 player co-op narrative campaign, competitive multiplayer as human or Ridden, and frenetic gameplay that keeps you in the action.
games.description: Back 4 Blood: Deluxe Edition includes:  • Base Game • 4 days Early Access to Back 4 Blood • Annual Pass: Three upcoming downloadable content drops with New Story, Playable Characters, Special Mutated Ridden, and more

games.name: Battlefield 1
games.summary: FPS de Première Guerre Mondiale. Battles dans la boue des trenchées d'Europe, sur les sables du Moyen-Orient et en Afrique. Narration émotionnelle, bande-son orchestrale, batailles épiques multijoueur.
games.description: A first-person shooter set during World War I, spanning multiple fronts from the muddy trenches of France to the Arabian desert and the Italian Alps. Features an anthology campaign with multiple playable characters, each with their own story, and large-scale 64-player multiplayer battles across iconic WWI locations.

games.name: Bloodborne
games.summary: Action-RPG exclusif PlayStation dans un Yharnam gothique infesté de créatures lovecraftiennes. Combat offensif et agressif, lore cryptique, atmosphère sombre unique. Chef-d'œuvre de FromSoftware.
games.description: A gothic action RPG set in the nightmarish city of Yharnam, plagued by a mysterious blood-borne illness. Players take on the role of a Hunter battling grotesque beasts and Lovecraftian horrors in an aggressive, fast-paced combat system that rewards offense over cautious defense. One of FromSoftware's greatest achievements.

games.name: Boulder Dash
games.summary: The game's protagonist, named "Rockford", must dig through caves collecting gems and diamonds and reach the exit within a specified time limit, while avoiding various types of dangerous creatures as well as obstacles like falling rocks and the constant danger of being crushed or trapped by an avalanche, or killed by an underground explosion.
games.description: Boulder Dash was originally released in 1984 for Atari 8-bit computers. It was developed and published by First Star Software, and spawned a series of sequels, re-releases, and spinoffs. It also did a great deal to establish and influence the mining genre of video games, which can be seen in modern games such as Minecraft, Spelunky, and Terraria.   The game is still available as a freemium mobile title developed by SoMa Play Inc for Android and iOS.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). IGN Wii VC review: positive — 'good game design never gets old.' GameFAQs user avg: Good (3.1/5). Classic puzzle game.

games.name: Breath of the Wild
games.summary: Révolution open-world de la série. Link explore un Hyrule post-apocalyptique 100 ans après la défaite face au Fléau de Ganon. Physique, chimie, escalade, glisse : liberté totale.
games.description: In this revolutionary open-world Zelda, Link awakens from a 100-year slumber in a post-apocalyptic Hyrule and must defeat Calamity Ganon. The game introduces unprecedented freedom of exploration, physics-based puzzle solving, and the ability to climb any surface — fundamentally changing what open-world games could be.

games.name: Cadence of Hyrule: Crypt of the NecroDancer Featuring The Legend of Zelda - Symphony of the Mask
games.summary: Play through a new story and map where Skull Kid takes center stage in the Symphony of the Mask DLC. This tale of the mischief maker includes a new map and songs.
games.description: A rhythm-based action RPG crossover where every action — moving, attacking, digging — must be made in time with iconic Zelda music. Play as Link, Zelda, or Cadence to defeat the sorcerer Octavo who has put Hyrule's heroes to sleep. The Symphony of the Mask DLC adds Skull Kid as a playable character with mask-swapping abilities.

games.name: The Callisto Protocol
games.summary: Survival horror sci-fi sur la Lune Europa. Jacob Lee, détenu dans la prison Black Iron, survit à une épidémie de mutations. Atmosphère claustrophobique, combat contre des biophètes mutants.
games.description: A survival horror game set on Jupiter's moon Europa in 2320, following prisoner Jacob Lee trapped in a maximum-security facility overrun by a deadly outbreak. Developed by Glen Schofield and Striking Distance Studios, it features brutal melee combat, grotesque enemies, and a deeply atmospheric sci-fi horror setting.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions Collector's Edition Includes:  Figurine: Exclusive Master Stars Piece (28cm) - Tsubasa Ozora All Japan Youth Artboard (285x310 mm) The Game Character Pass: 9 DLC Players Season Pass Bonus: new Champions Uniform Set Deluxe Edition Bonus: V Jump Collaboration Uniform Set 4 Rainbow Lamination Collectibles Cards Steelbook Embroidered Badges Collector's Box
games.description: An arcade football game based on the legendary Captain Tsubasa manga and anime series. Relive iconic matches featuring spectacular super shots, dramatic slidetackles, and story-driven football battles. Combines sports gameplay with manga-style presentation and special move animations.

games.name: Child of Light: Ultimate Edition + Valiant Hearts: The Great War
games.summary: Play the Child of Light Ultimate Edition and Valiant Hearts: The Great War bundle at home or on the go. Enjoy both games' intricately crafted worlds that tell deep and personal stories. Enjoy two great games in one bundle, providing hours of immersive entertainment. In Child of Light, join Aurora on her journey to save her ailing father and a lost kingdom in the magical world of Lemuria. Fight alongside your allies to upgrade your stats, unlock unique abilities, and use unique gems to improve your skills. In Valiant Hearts: The Great War, the lives of all the characters are inextricably drawn together over the course of the game. Choose your favorite control mode and experience the game with either a Joy-Con or the touch screen.
games.description: A bundle of two acclaimed Ubisoft narrative games. Child of Light is a fairy-tale turn-based RPG where young Aurora fights to save a fantasy realm using light-based combat, while Valiant Hearts is an emotional puzzle-adventure set during World War I following four characters connected by fate and a golden pendant.

games.name: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics
games.summary: Discover and play 51 tabletop games from around the world! Play and discover 51 board games, tabletop games, and more all in one package—Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics. This diverse collection includes games from all over the world across multiple genres, from familiar favorites like Chess to international hits like Mancala that have been around for 100s of years!  Enjoy familiar favorites and learn hidden gems from around the world in this collection of 51 board games, tabletop games and more! Whether you like to sit and strategize or rely on reflexes, Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics contains games from across an array of genres for you to play and discover. Each game is presented with stunning detail as dice clack and marbles glimmer. Strategic players will feel right at home with games like Four-in-a-row and Renegade, while those who prefer to use their reflexes can enjoy games like Slot Cars and Toy Boxing! With board games, card games, sports, solitaires and more, Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is an eclectic collection of games to play and discover on your Nintendo Switch. Enjoy 51 tabletop games and more from all over the world from the convenience of your Nintendo Switch system Play your favorite games or explore and learn new ones Play alone or with friends locally* and online** up to four players
games.description: A collection of 51 classic tabletop and card games including chess, mahjong, shogi, darts, bowling, billiards, and more. Designed for accessibility with clear tutorials, and supports local and online multiplayer for most games. An excellent digital board game compendium for players of all ages.

games.name: Collection of Mana
games.summary: A collection of the first 3 Seiken Densetsu games, known as the Mana series internationally, with a quick save feature added and all 3 soundtracks. The games included are Seiken Densetsu (Final Fantasy Adventure), Seiken Densetsu 2 (Secret of Mana), and Seiken Densetsu 3 (Trials of Mana).
games.description: A compilation of the first three games in the legendary Mana action RPG series: Final Fantasy Adventure, Secret of Mana, and Trials of Mana. Includes remastered versions alongside original releases, offering a complete look at the origins of the beloved franchise with its iconic ring menu combat system.

games.name: The Crew 2
games.summary: Jeu de course open-world avec véhicules terrestres, nautiques et aériens. Explorez des environnements mondiaux réalistes et participez à des compétitions multidisciplinaires.
games.description: An open-world racing game spanning land, sea, and air across real-world locations in America, Europe, and beyond. Drive supercars, ride powerboats, and fly planes across interconnected open-world environments. Features online multiplayer, live events, and a wide variety of motorsport disciplines.

games.name: Dark Souls
games.description: The seminal action RPG that defined the souls-like genre, set in the dying kingdom of Lordran. Players navigate a deeply interconnected world filled with undead creatures and powerful bosses, with brutally challenging combat demanding precision, patience, and learning from every death. The Limited Edition includes the Artorias of the Abyss DLC.
games.notes: Limited Edition

games.name: Dark Souls III: Game of the Year Edition
games.summary: Dernière entrée de la trilogie souls Lothric. Édition intégrale incluant les DLC Ashes of Ariandel et The Ringed City. Combat fluide, monde de cendres, boss épiques et lore profond.
games.description: The third and final Dark Souls set in the Kingdom of Lothric where the First Flame is fading. Features the fastest and most fluid combat in the trilogy, spectacular boss encounters, and a beautifully designed interconnected world. The Game of the Year Edition includes both DLC expansions: Ashes of Ariandel and The Ringed City.

games.name: Dark Souls Remastered
games.summary: Remaster HD du premier Dark Souls. Lordran revisité avec une résolution accrue, éclairage amélioré et DLC inclus. L'expérience souls-like fondatrice, plus accessible mais tout aussi exigeante.
games.description: A remastered version of the original Dark Souls featuring upgraded visuals in up to 4K/60fps, improved online multiplayer for up to 6 players, and the Artorias of the Abyss DLC included. The definitive way to experience the landmark game that established the souls-like genre and its iconic design philosophy.

games.name: Days Gone
games.summary: Open-world survival post-apocalyptique. Deacon St. John, motard survivant, traverse un Oregon infesté de Freakers (zombies) sur sa moto. Histoire émotionnelle, crafting et hordes massives.
games.description: An open-world survival game set in a post-apocalyptic Oregon overrun by Freakers — humans infected by a fungal pandemic. Play as Deacon St. John, a former outlaw biker, navigating massive Freaker hordes, hostile human factions, and personal grief on his motorcycle across a beautifully realized Pacific Northwest landscape.
games.notes: Special Edition

games.name: Dead Cells
games.summary: Roguelite Metroidvania de Motion Twin. Incarnez un prisonnier décapité qui contrôle un cadavre pour s'échapper d'une île maudite. Combat 2D fluide au style souls-lite, armes aléatoires, niveaux procéduraux et mort permanente. Pas de checkpoint — mourez, apprenez, recommencez.
games.description:
Dead Cells is a rogue-lite, metroidvania action-platformer developed by French indie studio Motion Twin. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you're able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

As the Prisoner, an amorphous creature inhabiting a headless corpse, you must fight your way out of a diseased island to slay the island's King. Procedurally generated levels ensure no two runs are the same. Permanent death strips you of all items, but a currency called Cells lets you buy lasting upgrades. Hundreds of weapons, spells and traps make each run feel unique.

games.name: Death's Door
games.description: An isometric action-adventure where a small crow works as a Reaper collecting souls for the mysterious Commission of Death. When a massive soul is stolen by an old witch, the crow must journey through a beautifully crafted world of secrets, challenging boss encounters, and an unexpectedly emotional story about mortality and purpose.
games.notes: Ultimate Edition

games.name: Death's Gambit: Afterlife - Definitive Edition
games.summary: Death’s Gambit: Afterlife is a 2D action Metroidvania that builds on and refines the original Death’s Gambit experience. Using an array of equipment, weapons, and abilities, Sorun must fight his way through the kingdom of Siradon to rid the land of its curse and fulfill his agreement with Death. Afterlife offers a wealth of new features and changes, including reworked movement, fine-tuned encounters, new bosses, levels, and more!
games.description: The Definitive Edition includes: - Physical copy of the game - Illustrated inner coversheet - Vinyl sticker sheet – set of 9 unique stickers - Double-sided poster

games.name: Demon's Souls
games.summary: Demon's Souls is set in a fictional dark fantasy world, taking part mostly in the southern medieval kingdom of Boletaria, that has been consumed by a thick, mysterious Fog that is creeping ever out to blanket the entire world. The Old One, a colossal immortal flying Demon, has been awoken and with it Demons have come forth to consume the souls of men. Only when The Old One is lulled back to eternal slumber will the fog dissipate and the world be restored.
games.description: Entirely rebuilt from the ground up and masterfully enhanced, Demon's Souls is a remake of the 2009 release that introduces the horrors of a fog-laden, dark fantasy land to a whole new generation of gamers. Those who’ve faced its trials and tribulations before, can once again challenge the darkness in stunning visual quality with incredible performance. The remake features improved graphics and animations, sound and lighting tweaks and a reimagining of many of the visual, musical and mechanical...

games.name: Destiny 2
games.summary: FPS/MMO de Bungie dans un univers sci-fi. Gardiens défendent la Terre et explorent le Système Solaire contre diverses factions aliens. Contenu online massif avec raids, PvP et saisons régulières.
games.description: A shared-world first-person shooter where Guardians protect humanity's last city against alien threats across the Solar System. Features a sprawling online world with story campaigns, cooperative raids and strikes, PvP Crucible modes, and a seasonal live-service model that has expanded massively since launch.

games.name: Detroit: Become Human
games.summary: Jeu narratif de Quantic Dream. Dans un Detroit futuriste, trois androïdes questionnent leur conscience et leur liberté. Une réflexion philosophique sur l'humanité, avec des décisions aux conséquences morales.
games.description: A narrative adventure set in a near-future Detroit where androids have begun developing consciousness and fighting for their rights. Play as three android protagonists — Connor, Kara, and Markus — navigating a branching story where every decision shapes the future of both androids and humanity across dozens of possible endings.

games.name: Devil May Cry 5 Special Edition
games.description: The stylish action series returns with three playable characters — Nero with his Devil Breaker prosthetic arm, the veteran demon hunter Dante, and the enigmatic V who commands demon familiars. This Special Edition adds Vergil as a fourth playable character, ray tracing, and performance enhancements exclusive to PS5.

games.name: Diablo III: Reaper of Souls
games.summary: Action-RPG isométrique de Blizzard complet. Combattez en Nephalem dans les enfers de Sanctuary. L'extension Reaper of Souls apporte Act V, le Croisier, le mode Aventure et la Rift montante.
games.description: An action RPG hack-and-slash where Nephalem heroes battle demonic forces across the world of Sanctuary. Reaper of Souls adds Act V, the Crusader class, Adventure Mode with Bounties and Nephalem Rifts, and the Mystic artisan for gear enchanting — transforming the base game into one of the most addictive loot-hunting experiences in gaming.

games.name: Diablo IV
games.summary: Action-RPG isométrique de Blizzard. Dans un Sanctuaire ravagé par le retour de Lilith, fille de Mephisto, les joueurs affrontent des hordes de démons dans un monde ouvert sombre et brutal.
games.description: The fourth entry in Blizzard's legendary action RPG franchise, set in a dark and brutal Sanctuary ravaged by the return of Lilith, daughter of Mephisto. Features a persistent open world shared with other players, five deeply customizable character classes, endgame Paragon boards, and an ongoing seasonal live-service with fresh challenges.

games.name: Dishonored 2
games.summary: Suite stealth-action à la première personne. Corvo et Emily Kaldwin affrontent une révolution dans Karnaca. Pouvoirs surnaturels, approche non-léthale possible, niveaux ouverts et réactifs.
games.description: A stealth-action sequel set in the coastal city of Karnaca, where either Corvo Attano or Emily Kaldwin reclaims the throne from a coup leader. Each character offers unique supernatural powers and every mission can be completed through stealth, violence, or a creative mix of both, with the chaos system shaping the world around your choices.

games.name: Divinity: Original Sin 2 Definitive Edition
games.summary: RPG tactique coop épique dans un monde d'écologie et de magie. Équipe jusqu'à 4 joueurs, combats au tour par tour profonds, système d'éléments détaillé. L'un des meilleurs RPG de la génération.
games.description: Widely considered one of the greatest RPGs ever made, featuring deep turn-based tactical combat, extraordinary freedom in character creation, and a richly interactive world. Play solo or in co-op with up to four players, making impactful choices that reshape the story across a sprawling world at war in the land of Rivellon.

games.name: Donkey Kong Classics
games.summary: What's more fun than a barrel of monkeys? A Donkey Kong double feature! In DONKEY KONG you'll duck barrel bombs and flaming fireballs as you help Mario save his girlfriend Pauline from the clutches of Donkey Kong. In DONKEY KONG JR., you'll join forces with these madcap monkeys to help Donkey Kong Jr. rescue his father from Mario's prison. Are you ready for laughter? You'd better be. Because this double dose of monkey business will have you rolling in the aisles!
games.description: A NES cartridge containing both the original Donkey Kong and Donkey Kong Jr. The first game features Mario (known as Jumpman) climbing girders to rescue Pauline from a rampaging ape, while the sequel reverses roles with Donkey Kong Jr. attempting to free his captured father from Mario's cage.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). Compilation of Donkey Kong + Donkey Kong Jr. on one NES cartridge. No formal aggregate score found.

games.name: Donkey Kong Country Returns 3D
games.summary: Over 70 levels of banana-hoarding fun featuring Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong. Run, jump, climb and defeat enemies through diverse environments until you retrieve Donkey Kong's stolen banana hoard. Rebuilt and optimized for portable play on the Nintendo 3DS system.
games.description: A 3DS port of Retro Studios' acclaimed Wii platformer, featuring Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong recovering their banana hoard from the Tiki Tak Tribe. Includes new levels and a new easier difficulty mode exclusive to the 3DS version alongside the original game's challenging and inventive platform design.

games.name: Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze
games.summary: Help Donkey Kong and his friends save their home and banana hoard from marauding Vikings in the Donkey Kong Country™: Tropical Freeze game from Retro Studios. All the challenging ground-pounding, barrel-blasting, side-scrolling mine cart action from the Donkey Kong Country series is back along with a bushel of new game play elements and features.
games.description: All the challenging ground-pounding, barrel-blasting, side-scrolling mine cart action from the Donkey Kong Country series is back along with a bushel of new game-play elements and features. And now, there are four playable characters! Dixie Kong is back to join the adventure as a playable character alongside Diddy Kong, and for the first time in Donkey Kong Country, bearded old hero Cranky Kong joins the adventure with his bouncy cane. Any of the three can buddy up with Donkey Kong, and each ch...

games.name: Donkey Kong Land
games.summary: Donkey Kong Land is a Jump & Run classic, developed by Rareware and released by Nintendo for the Game Boy in June 1995.  Cranky Kong, jealous of all the success Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong have had from Donkey Kong Country on the SNES, challenges the Kongs to beat another adventure on an 8-bit system (Game Boy). As King K. Rool agrees with Cranky and steals the bananas again, Donkey & Diddy Kong set out to go through another adventure!
games.description: A Game Boy platformer featuring Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong embarking on a new adventure to prove their first quest was real. Inspired by Donkey Kong Country with 30+ levels across four worlds, featuring barrel-blasting, animal buddies, and classic gameplay adapted for the Game Boy's monochrome screen.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). Well-regarded Game Boy platformer. Retro review scores range 8.5–9.2/10. MobyGames: positive user reception.

games.name: Doom
games.description: The 2016 reboot of the legendary id Software shooter franchise. Rip and tear through Hell's endless demon hordes on Mars in frantic, movement-based combat where aggression is rewarded with health and ammo. Features glory kills, a chainsaw, devastating weapons, and a legendary metal soundtrack by Mick Gordon.
games.notes: Big Box

games.name: Doom
games.summary: Reboot de Doom (2016) sur PS4. Le Doom Slayer massacre les hordes démoniaques de Malphas avec un arsenal dévastateur. FPS frnétique et brutal, bande-son métal de Mick Gordon iconique.
games.description: The 2016 Doom reboot on PlayStation 4. The Doom Slayer tears through demonic hordes in the UAC Mars facility and the depths of Hell itself. Brutal, fast-paced FPS gameplay with glory kills, weapon upgrades, and relentless momentum — one of the best shooters of its generation.

games.name: DOOM 64
games.summary: You killed the Demons once, they were all dead. Or so you thought... A single Demon Entity escaped detection. Systematically it altered decaying, dead carnage back into grotesque living tissue. The Demons have returned - stronger and more vicious than ever before. You mission is clear, there are no options: kill or be killed!
games.description: The original Nintendo 64 release of DOOM 64, a unique entry in the DOOM franchise developed by Midway Games. Features entirely new levels, a darker atmospheric tone compared to classic DOOM, new monster designs, the Unmaker weapon, and a story about the Doom Marine's final battle against the Mother Demon.
games.notes: Original N64 release (1997) predates Metacritic. IGN 1997 review: 7.4/10. Retroactively considered a hidden gem. The 2020 remaster scored 76 on Metacritic (already in mc_score on Switch/PC entries).

games.name: DOOM 64
games.summary: You killed the Demons once, they were all dead. Or so you thought... A single Demon Entity escaped detection. Systematically it altered decaying, dead carnage back into grotesque living tissue. The Demons have returned - stronger and more vicious than ever before. You mission is clear, there are no options: kill or be killed!
games.description: Originally released exclusively for the Nintendo 64 in 1997, DOOM 64 is a separate entry from the classic DOOM games featuring all-new levels, weapons, enemies, and a darker, more atmospheric tone. The Doom Marine returns to Hell once more to destroy the Mother Demon and prevent the resurrection of all demons.

games.name: DOOM 64
games.summary: You killed the Demons once, they were all dead. Or so you thought... A single Demon Entity escaped detection. Systematically it altered decaying, dead carnage back into grotesque living tissue. The Demons have returned - stronger and more vicious than ever before. You mission is clear, there are no options: kill or be killed!
games.description: The PC version of DOOM 64, a separate entry from the classic DOOM games originally exclusive to the Nintendo 64. Features all-new levels never seen in any other DOOM game, a darker horror atmosphere, a new weapon — the Unmaker — and a sinister story involving the resurrected Mother Demon.

games.name: Dragon Ball FighterZ
games.summary: Fighting game 2.5D avec les personnages de Dragon Ball. Combats en équipe de 3, animations cell-shading fidèles à l'animé, gameplay accessible mais profond.
games.description: A 2.5D fighting game featuring teams of three Dragon Ball characters in blazing fast battles with stunning cel-shaded visuals perfectly faithful to the anime. Developed by Arc System Works, it blends accessible controls with deep mechanics for competitive play, and includes a story mode featuring a new android villain.

games.name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot
games.summary: RPG narratif revivant l'histoire de Goku depuis Dragon Ball jusqu'à Dragon Ball Super. Combats intenses, cut-scenes cinématographiques, et missions secondaires exclusives enrichissant le lore.
games.description: An action RPG that retells the entire Dragon Ball Z saga from the Saiyan Arc through the Buu Arc. Players relive iconic battles as Goku and his allies across an open world, with side quests that expand the lore, cooking mini-games, and faithful recreation of the anime's most legendary moments and transformations.

games.name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
games.summary: Suite spirituelle de Budokai Tenkaichi. Combats de Dragon Ball ultra-intenses en 3D avec des dizaines de personnages. Sparking permet des batailles de 20 joueurs et des scénarios "What If" inédits.
games.description: The spiritual successor to the beloved Budokai Tenkaichi series, featuring 3D arena battles with over 180 playable characters from across the Dragon Ball universe. Play through canon and What If scenarios, battle online in matches up to 20 players, and experience the explosive, cinematic power of Dragon Ball combat.

games.name: Dragon Quest XI: Les Combattants de la destinée
games.summary: JRPG épique narrant le voyage de Sylvando et Hendrik pour lever la malédiction pesant sur le héros. Monde ouvert riche, turn-based classique magniftime en HD.
games.description: An epic JRPG following the Luminary, a young hero destined to save the world from the Dark Lord Mordegon. Features a sweeping narrative across a beautifully realized open world, classic turn-based combat with modernized presentation, a memorable cast of companions, and a stunning orchestral score.

games.name: Dragon's Crown Pro
games.summary: Beat'em up RPG 2.5D avec une direction artistique fantasy somptuese. Sorcière, Elfe, Nain, Amazone... Chaque classe joue différemment dans des niveaux colorés, coop jusqu'à 4 joueurs.
games.description: A side-scrolling beat 'em up RPG set in a stunning hand-painted 2D fantasy world by Vanillaware. Choose from six unique character classes — Fighter, Wizard, Elf, Dwarf, Sorceress, or Amazon — and adventure through increasingly challenging dungeons with co-op support for up to four players.

games.name: Driveclub
games.summary: Jeu de course social exclu PS4. Courses à travers le monde avec météo dynamique et progression de club. Connu pour ses visuels saisissants et sa simulation de conduite engageante.
games.description: A socially connected racing game for PlayStation 4 featuring licensed real-world cars and tracks from around the globe with a dynamic weather system. Compete as part of a club, earn points together in events, and race online with breathtaking visuals and atmospheric weather effects that dramatically change track conditions.

games.name: DuckTales
games.summary: The Beagle Boys attempt another raid on Scrooge's money bin, with Baggy, Burger and Bouncer Beagle capturing Huey, Dewey and Louie. After Scrooge rescues them, he finds Big Time Beagle in his office with a painting in his hands. With the help of Duckworth, Big Time is defeated and retreats. The painting reveals the locations of five treasures, and Scrooge wastes no time to set out for them. Scrooge and Launchpad visit the Amazon to find the Sceptre of the Incan King. Using eight golden coins, they uncover the hidden temple of Manco Capquack, but the sceptre is lost and the temple is destroyed by its guardian statue. The chief of the natives then approaches Scrooge and Launchpad and thanks them for returning their city to them, and gives Scrooge the recovered sceptre in return, which was just the king's back scratcher. Scrooge, the nephews and Webby visit the castle of Drake Von Vladstone, also known as Dracula Duck, who was the heir to the Coin of the Lost Realm. The boys fall into a trap door and are spread throughout the Transylvanian mansion, but Scrooge saves them from the Beagle Boys, disguised as ghosts. Each of the beagle boys were also carrying a torn sheet of paper which contained part of a riddle. They uncover a mirror where Scrooge solves the riddle, and Magica De Spell reveals herself, who is also after the coin. Scrooge and Magica then face off for it, and the sorceress is defeated and retreats empty-handed. Scrooge and the nephews travel to the African Mines to find the Giant Diamond of the Inner Earth, but they find the workers are being scared off by voices and earthquakes, claiming the mine is haunted. Deep underground, Scrooge discovers that the Terra-Firmians and their games are the cause, and after interfering he is attacked by their king. Defeated, the king makes an agreement with Scrooge to stop the games in exchange for the mining operations to continue, as it will rid them of the diamonds they consider to be "garbage rocks". He gives Scrooge the Giant Diamond of the Inner Earth to start with.
games.description: DuckTales is a platform game developed and published by Capcom and based on the Disney animated TV series of the same name. It was first released in North America for the Nintendo Entertainment System in 1989 and was later ported to the Game Boy in 1990. The story involves Scrooge McDuck traveling around the globe collecting treasure and outwitting his rival Flintheart Glomgold to become the world's richest duck.  Produced by key personnel from the Mega Man series, DuckTales would go on to sell...
games.notes: No Metacritic for original NES version (pre-Metacritic era). Considered a top-10 NES game by IGN. DuckTales Remastered (2013 remake) scored 79 on Metacritic.

games.name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
games.summary: Suite du jeu de zombies en monde ouvert. Aiden Caldwell, parkourreur, explore Villedor infestée. Combat corps-à-corps brutal, crafting d'armes, escalade et expériences de nuit terrifiantes.
games.description: Set 20 years after the original game, Aiden Caldwell must navigate the last great human settlement — a city overrun by the Infected — using parkour movement and brutal melee combat to survive. Your choices align with city factions, permanently changing its layout and who controls resources.

games.name: Echoes of Wisdom
games.summary: Premier Zelda principal avec Zelda comme protagoniste jouable. Elle utilise le Tri-Rod pour invoquer des Échos d'objets et d'ennemis. Retour au style 2D vue de dessus.
games.description: The first mainline Zelda game with Zelda as the playable protagonist. Armed with the Tri Rod, she creates Echoes — copies of objects and enemies — to solve puzzles and overcome foes in a top-down adventure across a dream-like version of Hyrule threatened by mysterious Rifts consuming the world.

games.name: Elden Ring: Collector's Edition
games.summary: Elden Ring is an action-RPG open world game with RPG elements such as stats, weapons and spells.  This edition includes the following Game: Elden Ring, 9" Statue of Malenia – Blade of Miquella, Steelbook, Artbook, Digital Sountrack (While supplies last)
games.description: Set in the shattered Lands Between, a vast open world crafted by Hidetaka Miyazaki and novelist George R.R. Martin, Elden Ring follows a Tarnished seeking to restore the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord. This Collector's Edition includes physical extras alongside the critically acclaimed FromSoftware souls-like epic.

games.name: Elden Ring: Collector's Edition
games.summary: Elden Ring is an action-RPG open world game with RPG elements such as stats, weapons and spells.  This edition includes the following Game: Elden Ring, 9" Statue of Malenia – Blade of Miquella, Steelbook, Artbook, Digital Sountrack (While supplies last)
games.description: Set in the shattered Lands Between, a vast open world crafted by Hidetaka Miyazaki and novelist George R.R. Martin, Elden Ring follows a Tarnished seeking to restore the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord. Includes enhanced PS5 performance, haptic feedback, and this Collector's Edition includes premium physical extras.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Switch
games.summary: Live another life, in another world—from battling ancient dragons, exploring rugged mountains, building a home, or mastering hundreds of weapons, spells and abilities. For the first time ever, go into battle Legend of Zelda style: fight with the Master Sword, guard with the Hylian Shield, while wearing the Champion's Tunic. The game also includes official add-ons—Dawnguard, Hearthfire, and Dragonborn.
games.description: Dragons, long lost to the passages of the Elder Scrolls, have returned and the future of Skyrim hangs in the balance. As Dragonborn, the prophesized hero born with the power of The Voice, you are the only one who can stand against them.

games.name: The Evil Within 2
games.summary: Suite d'Evil Within. Sebastian Castellanos part à la recherche de sa fille disparue dans un monde cauchemardesque. Survival horror psychologique à la troisième personne.
games.description: Sebastian Castellanos searches for his missing daughter in a nightmarish reality called STEM. A psychological survival horror sequel with more open environments than the original, greater narrative focus, and a cast of memorable supporting characters. Directed by John Johanas at Tango Gameworks.

games.name: Fallout 76
games.summary: Spin-off de Fallout en MMO online. Construction de bases, exploration post-apocalyptique de Virginie-Occidentale, et survie dans un monde irradié sans PNJ humains au lancement.
games.description: The first online multiplayer Fallout game, set in West Virginia 25 years after nuclear war. Explore the Appalachian wasteland solo or with friends, build C.A.M.P. settlements, complete quests, and encounter other players in a shared persistent world that has been substantially expanded since its troubled launch.

games.name: Farpoint
games.summary: FPS VR exclusif PlayStation VR avec le PS Aim Controller. Atterri sur une planète alien hostile, combattez des araignées extraterrestres géantes. Immersion complète grâce au fusil haptique.
games.description: A VR first-person shooter designed specifically for the PlayStation VR headset with optional PS Aim Controller support. Stranded on an alien planet following a catastrophic incident, players fight through hostile extraterrestrial creatures while uncovering the mystery of a massive space anomaly pulling everything toward it.

games.name: FIFA 18
games.summary: Simulation de football FIFA 18 avec le moteur Frostbite. Mode Histoire avec Alex Hunter, Ultimate Team amélioré, et les meilleurs joueurs mondiaux sous licence officielle.
games.description: EA Sports' flagship football simulation powered by the Frostbite engine, featuring the return of The Journey story mode following Alex Hunter into Europe's top leagues. Offers the most authentic football experience of its generation with Ultimate Team, Career Mode, and online multiplayer.

games.name: FIFA 22
games.summary: Powered by Football, FIFA 22 brings the game even closer to the real thing with fundamental gameplay advances and a new season of innovation across every mode. Play with 17,000+ players, over 700 teams in 90+ stadiums and more than 30 leagues from all over the globe.
games.description: EA Sports' football simulation featuring HyperMotion technology, which used machine learning trained on real-life match data to power over 4,000 new animations. Offers enhanced Career Mode, expanded Volta Football, a revamped Ultimate Team with Division Rivals, and represents one of the final entries in the FIFA-branded series.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.description: An expanded PS5 version of the critically acclaimed Final Fantasy VII Remake, featuring enhanced performance, ray tracing, DualSense haptic feedback, and the all-new Interlude chapter starring Yuffie Kisaragi infiltrating Shinra. The Remake reimagines the first section of the classic FFVII — the escape from Midgar — as a full standalone action RPG.

games.name: Final Fantasy XV
games.summary: JRPG épique avec Noctis et ses amis dans un road trip à travers Eos. Combat en temps réel, monde ouvert, et une histoire de sacrifice et de fraternité touchante.
games.description: An epic JRPG following Prince Noctis and his three companions on a road trip across the world of Eos to reclaim his kingdom from an imperial invasion. Features a seamless open world, a real-time combat system blending magic and weaponry, and an emotionally powerful story about brotherhood and sacrifice.

games.name: Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest
games.summary: Focus Tower is the center of the world and balances the forces of the world. However 4 monsters have taken the 4 elemental crystals (Earth, Water, Fire, Wind) for their own use, and also taken the 4 keys that for doors inside of Focus Tower. With the balance disrupted, disasters befall the world. A young boy by the name of Benjamin finds his home village destroyed. Meeting a mysterious old man while trying to escape from earthquakes, he soon learns that he is the prophesized hero and the only one who can save the world. Benjamin must recover the 4 crystals, unlock Focus Tower and defeat the ultimate monster before the 5th crystal, the Crystal of Life is corrupted.
games.description: A simplified Final Fantasy RPG originally designed for Western audiences new to the genre. Follow Benjamin as he fights to restore peace to the world of Mystic Quest, with straightforward turn-based combat, linear progression, and an accessible structure that makes it an approachable entry point into JRPGs.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). IGN described it as 'entry-level RPG, not entirely terrible.' HowLongToBeat user rating: 62%. Considered the easiest Final Fantasy.

games.name: Four Swords Adventures
games.summary: Zelda multijoueur sur GameCube. Ganon ressuscite et Link doit parcourir Hyrule avec ses ombres pour collecter les Pierres Sacrées. Conçu pour le multijoueur local avec le câble GBA.
games.description: A top-down Zelda adventure focused on cooperative multiplayer gameplay. Ganon is resurrected and scatters the four Links across Hyrule, who must work together to retrieve the Dark Mirror. Designed around local multiplayer using GBA-to-GameCube link cables, though playable solo with AI companions.

games.name: Game & Watch: Super Mario Bros.
games.summary: Console portable Game & Watch rééditée par Nintendo. Contient Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 2, Ball, et une horloge animée. Écran couleur rétroéclairé, édition collector limitée.
games.description: A limited-edition Game & Watch handheld released for the 35th anniversary of Super Mario Bros. Features a colour LCD screen running Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, and the classic Ball game, along with an animated clock. A collector's item celebrating Nintendo's iconic history.
games.notes: Hardware — Console/Game

games.name: Game & Watch: Super Mario Bros. (Color Screen)
games.summary: Édition spéciale Game & Watch Super Mario Bros. avec écran couleur (différente de la version standard). Contient les mêmes jeux avec un design légèrement différent.
games.description: The Color Screen variant of the Game & Watch Super Mario Bros. limited-edition handheld. Contains the same games as the standard edition — Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, and Ball — with the same animated clock feature celebrating the franchise's 35th anniversary.
games.notes: Hardware — Console/Box (Color Screen edition)

games.name: Game & Watch: The Legend of Zelda
games.summary: Édition Game & Watch dédiée à The Legend of Zelda pour les 35 ans de la franchise. Contient Zelda, Zelda II, Link's Awakening, et une horloge animée. Écran couleur rétroéclairé.
games.description: A limited-edition Game & Watch handheld released for the 35th anniversary of The Legend of Zelda. Features a colour screen running the original Legend of Zelda, Zelda II: The Adventure of Link, and Link's Awakening (Game Boy), plus an animated Zelda-themed clock. A must-have collector's piece for Zelda fans.
games.notes: Hardware — Console/Game

games.name: God of War
games.summary: Kratos, dieu de la guerre spèn, et son fils Atreus traversent les Neuf Royaumes nordiques. Un chef-dœuvre narratif mêlant action brutale et émotion parentale.
games.description: A reimagining of the God of War franchise set in Norse mythology. Kratos, the Spartan god of war, raises his son Atreus in the wilds of Midgard while confronting gods, monsters, and his own violent past. Praised as a masterpiece for its cinematic storytelling, emotional depth, and satisfying combat.

games.name: Gran Turismo 7
games.summary: Explore all that the Real Driving Simulator can be with new tools to help you put your own mark on your driving experiences.  Collect, tune, race and customize hundreds of cars and create your dream garage collection.  Join an international community of drivers to share race strategies, tuning tips, livery designs and photos, before taking to the track to go head-to-head.
games.description: Gran Turismo 7 brings together the very best features of the Real Driving Simulator. Whether you’re a competitive or casual racer, collector, tuner, livery designer or photographer – find your line with a staggering collection of game modes including fan-favorites like GT Campaign, Arcade and Driving School. With the reintroduction of the legendary GT Simulation Mode, buy, tune, race and sell your way through a rewarding solo campaign as you unlock new cars and challenges. And if you love going...

games.name: Gran Turismo Sport
games.summary: Course GT en ligne avec acréditation FIA. Simulation racing avec voitures sous licence et circuits réels. Sport Mode avec eSports officiels, gestion de livrée et communauté mondiale de pilotes.
games.description: A socially connected racing simulator built around the FIA-certified Sport Mode, with online championships watched by real audiences. Polyphony Digital crafted a stunning visual showcase for PS4 featuring meticulously modeled cars, dynamic weather, and an eSports ecosystem with official FIA certification.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
games.summary: Monde ouvert criminel dans la ville fictive de Los Santos. Jouez en tant que Trevor, Michael et Franklin dans une histoire d'hébergement et de trahison. Online énormément joué en multijoueur.
games.description: The definitive open-world crime game set in the fictional Los Santos. Play as three protagonists — Michael, Trevor, and Franklin — whose stories intertwine in a heist-driven narrative. Features a massive sandbox world, a deep single-player campaign, and the ever-evolving GTA Online multiplayer mode.

games.name: Hades
games.summary: Zagreus, the son of Hades, has discovered that his mother, which he was led to believe was Nyx, Night Incarnate, is actually someone else, and is outside Hell. He is now attempting to escape his father's domain, with the help of the other gods of Olympus, in an attempt to find his real mother.
games.description: A rogue-lite hack and slash dungeon crawler in which Zagreus, son of Hades the Greek god of the dead, attempts to escape his home and his oppressive father by fighting the souls of the dead through the various layers of the ever-shifting underworld, while getting to know and forging relationships with its inhabitants.

games.name: The Heavy Rain & BEYOND: Two Souls Collection
games.summary: Collection incluant Heavy Rain et Beyond: Two Souls. Jeux narratifs interactifs de David Cage. Chaque décision influence le destin des personnages dans des thrillers psychologiques intenses.
games.description: A PS4 collection of Heavy Rain and Beyond: Two Souls, two narrative-driven PS3 games from Quantic Dream. Heavy Rain follows multiple characters trying to stop the Origami Killer, while Beyond: Two Souls stars Ellen Page as a woman with a supernatural entity attached to her soul across 15 years of her life.

games.name: Horizon Zero Dawn
games.summary: Action-RPG open-world post-apocalyptique. Aloy, chasseuse dans un monde repris par des machines-animaux, découvre les secrets de son passé et de la civilisation disparue.
games.description: An action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world reclaimed by nature and mechanical creatures. Aloy, an outcast hunter, uncovers the secrets of the fallen civilization that created the machines threatening humanity's survival. Features a vast open world, bow-based combat, and a gripping mystery narrative.

games.name: Just Dance 2016
games.summary: Just Dance brings the best hits like “Blame” by Calvin Harris Ft. John Newman and “Uptown Funk” by Marc Ronson Ft. Bruno Mars to dance and sing along to, with the usual golden treasures like “Let’s Groove” by Equinox Stars that makes Just Dance a must-have to play with friends and family! No additional device is required, with the free Just Dance Controller App to play and use your smartphone as a controller! Discover Just Dance Unlimited, the new subscription streaming service to play your favorite hits from past Just Dance games (accessible on Wii U, PS4, XboxOne).
games.description: A dance game featuring 40 songs from pop hits of 2015. Players mirror choreographed dance moves scored on accuracy and enthusiasm. Features multiplayer for up to four players, a Kids Mode with family-friendly content, and World Dance Floor online features. Compatible with Wii Remote motion controls.

games.name: Just Dance 2017
games.summary: Grab your friends and family: it’s time to dance! Just Dance is back with over 40 new tracks, 6 games modes, and ever more songs through Just Dance Unlimited subscription service! Featuring the ultimate tracklist including Cheap Thrills by Sia Ft. Sean Paul, Sorry by Justin Bieber and many more!
games.description: A dance game featuring 40 songs from pop hits of 2016-2017. The first Just Dance on Nintendo Switch, playable with a single Joy-Con as the controller. Features local multiplayer for up to six players, kids mode, and Just Dance Controller app support. One of the Switch launch-adjacent titles.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary: Sora et ses alliés Disney/Pixar affrontent Xehanort dans une conclusion épique à la saga. Mondes immenses, système Attraction Flow et une narration émotionnelle intense.
games.description: The long-awaited conclusion to the Xehanort saga in the Kingdom Hearts universe. Sora and his friends travel through worlds based on Disney and Pixar films to recruit the Seven Guardians of Light for the final confrontation against Master Xehanort and the Real Organization XIII.

games.name: Kirby Star Allies
games.summary: Kirby is back in this new title coming to the Nintendo Switch console in HD. Recruit enemies as helpers, use Kirby copy abilities such as Sword, Fire and Water, and join forces with up to three friends for a different kind of team-up action.
games.description: A charming cooperative platformer where Kirby teams up with up to three friends to traverse Dream Land. By inhaling certain enemies and using Friend Hearts, Kirby can grant companions unique copy abilities. Features classic Kirby gameplay with a bright, cheerful aesthetic and accessible difficulty.

games.name: The Last Guardian
games.summary: In a strange and mystical land, a young boy discovers a mysterious creature with which he forms a deep, unbreakable bond. The unlikely pair must rely on each other to journey through towering, treacherous ruins filled with unknown dangers. Experience the journey of a lifetime in this touching, emotional story of friendship and trust.
games.description: A third-person puzzle-adventure where a boy forms a bond with a giant, half-eagle, half-cat creature named Trico. Together they navigate ancient ruins and escape a mysterious fortress. Directed by Fumito Ueda, it features emotional storytelling, breathtaking animation, and puzzles built around the relationship between boy and beast.

games.name: The last of us Part 1;
games.description: A ground-up remake of the original The Last of Us for PlayStation 5, rebuilt using the PS5's full capabilities. Joel and Ellie's harrowing cross-country journey in a post-fungal-apocalypse America is retold with completely new character models, animations, AI behaviors, and DualSense haptic feedback support.

games.name: The Last of Us Remastered
games.summary: Remaster PS4 du chef-d'œuvre PS3. Joel escorte Ellie à travers les États-Unis post-apocalyptiques ravagés par un champignon parasitaire. Narration et tension émotionnelle uniques.
games.description: A remastered version of Naughty Dog's landmark 2013 survival game for PlayStation 4. Joel, a hardened survivor, escorts the immune teenager Ellie across a post-fungal-apocalypse America. Widely regarded as one of the greatest games ever made for its storytelling, character work, and atmosphere.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda
games.summary: In the small kingdom in the land of Hyrule, is engulfed in chaos after an army led by Ganon, the Prince of Darkness, invaded it and stole the Triforce of Power, a part of a magical artifact bestowing great strength. In an attempt to prevent Ganon from acquiring the Triforce of Wisdom, another of the pieces, Princess Zelda splits it and hides the eight fragments in secret dungeons throughout the land. Before the princess is eventually kidnapped by Ganon, she commands her nursemaid Impa to find someone courageous enough to save the kingdom. While wandering the land, the old woman is surrounded by Ganon's henchmen, though a young boy named Link appears and rescues her. After hearing Impa's plea, he resolves to save Zelda and sets out to reassemble the scattered fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom, to become powerful enough to defeat Ganon.
games.description: Set in the fantasy land of Hyrule, the plot centers on a boy named Link, the playable protagonist, who aims to collect the eight fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom in order to rescue Princess Zelda from the antagonist, Ganon. During the course of the game, the player sees Link from a top-down perspective and must navigate him through the overworld and several dungeons, defeating enemies and finding secrets along the way.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda
games.summary: In the small kingdom in the land of Hyrule, is engulfed in chaos after an army led by Ganon, the Prince of Darkness, invaded it and stole the Triforce of Power, a part of a magical artifact bestowing great strength. In an attempt to prevent Ganon from acquiring the Triforce of Wisdom, another of the pieces, Princess Zelda splits it and hides the eight fragments in secret dungeons throughout the land. Before the princess is eventually kidnapped by Ganon, she commands her nursemaid Impa to find someone courageous enough to save the kingdom. While wandering the land, the old woman is surrounded by Ganon's henchmen, though a young boy named Link appears and rescues her. After hearing Impa's plea, he resolves to save Zelda and sets out to reassemble the scattered fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom, to become powerful enough to defeat Ganon.
games.description: Set in the fantasy land of Hyrule, the plot centers on a boy named Link, the playable protagonist, who aims to collect the eight fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom in order to rescue Princess Zelda from the antagonist, Ganon. During the course of the game, the player sees Link from a top-down perspective and must navigate him through the overworld and several dungeons, defeating enemies and finding secrets along the way.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda
games.summary: L'opus fondateur de la franchise. Link explore Hyrule, défiant Ganon pour récupérer les fragments de la Triforce et sauver la Princesse Zelda. Premier Action-RPG en monde ouvert de Nintendo.
games.description: The foundational Legend of Zelda entry that established action-adventure gaming. Link navigates the overworld of Hyrule and nine labyrinthine dungeons to collect the fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom and defeat Ganon, rescuing Princess Zelda. Pioneered open-world exploration and non-linear design in console games.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
games.summary: The events of A Link Between Worlds take place six generations after the events of A Link to the Past. The legend of the legendary hero's battles against Ganon has been passed down from generation to generation, and peace has ruled for decades. The game's incarnation of Link is an apprentice blacksmith to Hyrule's greatest Blacksmith.  Beset by a nightmare of the sacred Triforce being destroyed and facing a gargantuan evil creature, Link is awakened from his sleep by Gulley, the Blacksmith's son. Link rushes over to the smithery, where the Captain of Hyrule's knights has stopped by to retrieve his sword and shield. After Link is scolded for being late, the Blacksmith's Wife notices that the Captain forgot to bring his sword along with him when he left. Link is tasked with traveling to Hyrule Castle to return it to its rightful owner. Once Link arrives at the castle however, he is told that the Captain went to the Sanctuary. Upon his arrival there, however, the villain Yuga appears, and turns both Seres and the Captain into paintings with his wicked magic. Link lunges at Yuga, but Yuga is able to use his magic to turn himself into a wall painting, causing Link to crash straight into the wall. Yuga then returns to his original form, kicking Link to the floor in the process. As Yuga leaves with Seres in tow, the Priest says to warn Princess Zelda of this before Link passes out.
games.description: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds is the first Zelda game made exclusively for the Nintendo 3DS. A daring adventure awaits Link in Hyrule, where he can use his new ability to become a "drawing" and move along walls of dungeons. This opens up ways to explore and puzzle elements that give Link access to locations he could not otherwise reach.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.summary: Link awakes in a mysterious chamber after 100 years of slumber to find that Calamity Ganon has taken over Hyrule Castle and left Hyrule to decay and be taken over by nature.
games.description: In this 3D open-world entry in the Zelda series, Link is awakened from a deep slumber without his past memories in the post-apocalyptic Kingdom of Hyrule, and sets off on a journey to defeat the ancient evil Calamity Ganon. Link treks, climbs and glides through fields, forests and mountain ranges while meeting and helping friendly folk and defeating enemies in order to gather up the strength to face Ganon.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening - Limited Edition
games.summary: This version contains:  - The base game: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening - A steelcase simulating a Game Boy. - A 120 page Artbook.
games.description: The Limited Edition of The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening for Nintendo Switch, including the base game in a special collector's packaging with a Dreamer Edition steelbook and artbook. The same beloved remake with its charming diorama toy aesthetic and Chamber Dungeon creator mode.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
games.summary: A Nintendo 3DS remake of the Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask that features graphical modernizations and gameplay changes, including quality-of-life improvements, UI streamlining, additional options for aiming controls and difficulty tweaks.
games.description: A 3DS remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, featuring enhanced visuals in stereoscopic 3D, redesigned boss battles, new save mechanics via the Bomber's Notebook, and gyroscope aiming. Makes the haunting three-day time loop adventure more accessible while preserving its oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D - Special Edition
games.summary: PAL region exclusive special bundle containing the game, a Steelbook case, a poster and a Majora's Mask pin.
games.description: The Special Edition of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D, including the base remaster alongside exclusive physical collectibles such as a Skull Kid figure and collector's items. The game itself is the enhanced 3DS remaster of the N64 classic featuring the three-day time loop in Termina.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
games.summary: A young Kokiri boy discovers that his destiny is to free the Seven Sages and save the land of Hyrule from the treacherous sorcerer Ganondorf.
games.description: A Nintendo 3DS remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998), originally for the Nintendo 64, with more up-to-date graphics, streamlined UI, alternative aiming controls, different additional game modes and difficulty tweaks.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
games.summary: An HD remaster of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (2002) with an alternate recreation of the original's art style, several gameplay adjustments and quality-of-life improvements.
games.description: An HD remaster of The Wind Waker for Wii U, featuring stunning updated visuals that make the cel-shaded art style shine, a Swift Sail for faster ocean travel, GamePad inventory management, and Tingle Bottles replacing Tingle Tuner. One of the most beautiful Zelda games brought to full HD.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
games.summary: Link, a young man from a small farming village, finds Hyrule is being consumed by an otherworldly twilight. Guided by a strange pixie named Midna, he endeavors to return light to the land and confront the usurper king Zant.
games.description: Link, a young man raised as a wrangler in a small, rural village, is ordered by the mayor to attend the Hyrule Summit. He sets off, oblivious to the dark fate that has descended upon the kingdom. When he enters the Twilight Realm that has covered Hyrule, he transforms into a wolf and is captured. A mysterious figure named Midna helps him break free, and with the aid of her magic, they set off to free the land from the shadows. Link must explore the vast land of Hyrule and uncover the mystery be...

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD
games.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess is a critically acclaimed masterpiece, set in a massive world bursting with life - but also shadow. A dark figure from the Twilight Realm has invaded the world of light. As Link, a farmhand turned cursed beast, join forces with the impish Midna and trusted allies to survive a quest that'll take you to the farthest corners of Hyrule and beyond... to the Twilight Realm. This emotional adventure comes with improved visuals and controls and new challenges. Choose Hero Mode to take 2x normal damage, or tap the Wolf Link amiibo figure to unlock the tough Cave of Shadows.
games.description: An HD remaster of Twilight Princess for Wii U featuring 1080p resolution, improved lighting, an amiibo-compatible Cave of Shadows dungeon, and the Wolf Link amiibo. The beloved 2006 Zelda epic retold with enhanced visuals and GamePad functionality for item management.

games.name: LEGO Harry Potter Collection
games.summary: Collection LEGO des années 1 à 7 de Harry Potter. Revivez l'intégralité de Poudlard en briques LEGO avec humour, puzzles et exploration dans le monde magique.
games.description: A PS4 collection of LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4 and LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7, covering the entire Wizarding World saga in LEGO form. Explore Hogwarts, Diagon Alley, and beyond with over 200 characters, solving puzzles and reliving iconic moments from all eight films with signature LEGO humour.

games.name: LEGO Ninjago
games.description: A LEGO action platformer based on the LEGO Ninjago animated series. Players control Spinjitzu ninja warriors fighting the Serpentine evil forces across multiple worlds, with each ninja having unique elemental powers and abilities. Features cooperative gameplay and collectibles across all levels.

games.name: Link's Awakening
games.summary: Link se réveille sur l'île de Koholint après un naufrage. Pour rentrer chez lui, il doit réveiller le Poisson-Rêve en collectant 8 instruments de musique. Aventure poétique sur Game Boy.
games.description: Link washes ashore on the mysterious Koholint Island after a shipwreck and must awaken the Wind Fish by collecting eight Instruments of the Sirens to escape. A poetic, introspective adventure with a dreamlike quality unlike any other Zelda, memorable characters, and a surprising emotional conclusion.

games.name: Link's Awakening (remake)
games.summary: Remake de Link's Awakening (1993) avec un style graphique diorama en miniature. Même aventure sur l'île de Koholint, entièrement reconstruite avec des graphismes en argile.
games.description: A gorgeous remake of the 1993 Game Boy classic Link's Awakening, rebuilt from scratch with a charming toy-like diorama art style. Preserves the original's beloved story and puzzle design while adding smooth modern controls, Chamber Dungeons for custom dungeon creation, and enhanced visuals running at 60fps.

games.name: Luigi's Mansion 3
games.summary: Luigi embarks on a dream vacation with Mario and friends upon receiving an invitation to a luxurious hotel. However, his dream quickly becomes a nightmare when King Boo reveals everything had been a ploy to capture Mario and friends. With the assistance of Professor E. Gadd once again, the reluctant and cowardly hero Luigi traverses up and down treacherous floors of the now-ominous hotel on a quest to save them.
games.description: Luigi and his Poltergust G-00 vacuum venture into the Last Resort hotel to rescue Mario and friends from the ghost king King Boo. Features 17 themed floors to explore, engaging boss fights, the Gooigi mechanic for puzzle-solving, and a local co-op ScareScraper mode for up to eight players.

games.name: Majora's Mask
games.summary: Suite directe d'Ocarina of Time. Link doit empêcher la Lune de s'écraser sur Termina en 3 jours, en boucle temporelle. Ambiance sombre et mélancolique unique dans la série.
games.description: A direct sequel to Ocarina of Time set in the parallel world of Termina. Link has three in-game days to prevent the Moon from crashing into the world, endlessly reliving those three days using the Ocarina of Time. Darker and more emotionally complex than any Zelda before or since.

games.name: Majora's Mask 3D
games.summary: Remaster de Majora's Mask pour 3DS. Graphismes améliorés, nouvelles fonctionnalités de sauvegarde, Boss remaniés. L'aventure cauchemardesque de Termina enfin sur portable.
games.description: A remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask for Nintendo 3DS, featuring enhanced stereoscopic 3D visuals, reworked save mechanics, redesigned boss fights, and various quality-of-life improvements. The 3DS version makes the haunting three-day time loop adventure more accessible while preserving its unique atmosphere.

games.name: Man of Medan
games.summary: Horreur interactive multijoueur inspirée de Until Dawn. Cinq amis explorent un cargo abandonné hanté. Vos choix déterminent qui survit dans cette aventure de terreur atmosphérique.
games.description: A horror anthology game from Supermassive Games set in the Dark Pictures universe. Five friends explore an abandoned WWII cargo ship, the Medan, where something sinister happened decades ago. Every decision can lead to character death, with all five companions potentially surviving or perishing based on player choices.

games.name: Mario & Sonic at the Rio 2016 Olympic Games
games.description: A sports party game celebrating the Rio 2016 Olympic Games, featuring over 300 events across 14 sports disciplines. Play as Mario and Sonic characters competing in athletics, gymnastics, swimming, and combat sports across iconic Brazilian settings, with local multiplayer for up to four players.

games.name: Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle
games.summary: The Mushroom Kingdom has been torn apart by a mysterious vortex, transporting the chaotic Rabbids into this once peaceful land. To restore order, Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach and Yoshi must team up with a whole new crew: four Rabbids heroes! Together, they will battle with weapons through four worlds filled with combat, puzzles, and unpredictable enemies.
games.description: This is the story of an unexpected encounter between Mario and the irreverent Rabbids. The Mushroom Kingdom has been torn apart by a mysterious vortex, transporting the Rabbids into the once-peaceful area, splintering this beloved land. To bring order back to the Kingdom, Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, and Yoshi team up with Rabbids heroes in a journey through four different worlds.

games.name: Mario Kart 7
games.description: The seventh entry in the Mario Kart series and the first on Nintendo 3DS, introducing hang-glider sections, underwater driving, and customizable karts. Features 32 courses across 8 cups, online races for up to 8 players, and was a launch window highlight that became one of the best-selling 3DS games.

games.name: Mario Kart 8
games.summary: Turn your racing experience upside down! Nintendo’s Mario Kart franchise comes to the Wii U console in full HD, introducing new racing circuit designs and anti-gravity karts that will have players driving upside down. And for the first time, all of Bowser’s seven Koopalings are playable characters-- get a taste of being bad on the race track by playing as Iggy, Larry, Lemmy, Ludwig, Morton, Roy and Wendy. Players will also enjoy a variety of series-favorite features, including the return of 12-player online competitive play, hang-gliders, underwater racing and motorbikes.
games.description: The eighth entry in the Mario Kart series and the first on Wii U, featuring anti-gravity racing sections where karts drive on walls and ceilings. Includes 32 courses, 30 racers, and local multiplayer for up to four players. The DLC later added 16 additional courses and 6 extra characters.

games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.summary: Hit the road with the definitive version of Mario Kart 8 and play anytime, anywhere! Race your friends or battle them in a revised battle mode on new and returning battle courses. Play locally in up to 4-player multiplayer in 1080p while playing in TV Mode. Every track from the Wii U version, including DLC, makes a glorious return. Plus, the Inklings appear as all-new guest characters, along with returning favorites, such as King Boo, Dry Bones, and Bowser Jr.!
games.description: The definitive version of Mario Kart 8, featuring all 48 original courses plus the 16 DLC courses, 42 racers, and improved Battle Mode with five distinct modes. The best-selling Nintendo Switch game, featuring online races for up to 12 players and local multiplayer for up to four.

games.name: Mario Kart Wii
games.summary: Mario Kart Wii is a multiplayer-oriented racing game for the Wii, and the sixth main installment in the Mario Kart series. Mario Kart Wii retains the traditional item-based weaponry familiar with the franchise, where players can select a Mario franchise driver and themed vehicles. As with most racing games, the overarching goal is to place first among other competitors, through the usage of such items and taking the fastest routes to secure the leads. Several new key elements introduced to Mario Kart Wii include increasing the number of racers to 12 racers from 8 racers from previous entries in the series, as well as introducing a new type of vehicle to the franchise: bikes. The game takes advantage of features unique to the Wii, most notably its motion control capabilities. A Wii Wheel is included in most Mario Kart Wii packages, though the game is still compatible with other controllers. Game modes are also present such as the traditional Grand Prix, Versus, Battle, and Time Trial modes.
games.description: The sixth Mario Kart and the first to support online multiplayer, featuring the iconic Wii Wheel motion control and support for up to 12 racers online. Includes 32 courses, motorbikes as a new vehicle class, and the introduction of performing tricks on ramps for speed boosts.

games.name: Mario Kart World
games.summary: Mario Kart World est le premier opus de la franchise sur Nintendo Switch 2, avec des courses en monde ouvert connectées entre elles pour la première fois de la série.
games.description: The first Mario Kart game for Nintendo Switch 2, introducing open-world courses seamlessly connected to each other for the first time in the franchise. Features a massive map of interconnected race routes, a new roster of racers, and fully reimagined racing mechanics tailored for the new hardware.
games.notes: Nintendo Switch 2

games.name: Mario Party: The Top 100
games.summary: The "best" of Mario Party arrives on 3DS.
games.description: A celebration of Mario Party's history, collecting 100 of the best minigames from across the first ten entries in the series. Play through a board-style campaign unlocking minigames in themed groups, or challenge friends in Free Play. Designed as a portable minigame collection for 3DS.

games.name: Mario Strikers: Battle League
games.summary: Introducing Mario Strikers: Battle League, a 5-on-5, soccer-like sport with no rules - do whatever it takes to win! Get gritty and try to score the most goals by tackling enemies, using items, and pulling off score-boosting special shots. Super Mario series mainstays like Peach, Toad, and Yoshi put their cleats (and stats) to the pitch and will stop at nothing to score. Customize your characters with gear that can augment their stats and appearance. Take the carnage online or pass the ball to players locally - just look out for the electric fence.
games.description: An intense 5v5 soccer game set in the Mario universe, featuring aggressive tackles, special moves, and electric fence-bordered pitches. Each player has unique stats and Hyper Strike abilities. Features local and online multiplayer up to eight players, as well as a single-player Cup Battle mode.

games.name: Mario Tennis Aces
games.summary: A new Mario Tennis game is bringing a new level of skill and competition to Nintendo Switch. Mario steps onto the court in classy tennis garb for intense rallies against a variety of characters in full-blown tennis battles. New wrinkles in tennis gameplay will challenge your ability to read an opponent's position and stroke to determine which shot will give you the advantage. And this time the game adds the first story mode since the Mario Tennis game on Game Boy Advance, offering a new flavor of tennis gameplay, with a variety of missions, boss battles and more
games.description: A tennis game featuring Mario characters with Adventure Mode, where players progress through courts and unlock new moves. Features trick shots, zone shots, and special abilities for each character. Includes singles, doubles, and online multiplayer tournaments.

games.name: Mario Tennis Fever
games.summary: Mario Tennis Fever est un jeu de tennis arcade développé par Camelot pour la Nintendo Switch 2, avec des mécaniques de jeu de tennis dynamiques et des personnages de l'univers Mario.
games.description: A tennis game developed by Camelot for Nintendo Switch 2, featuring Mario characters with enhanced shot mechanics and new gameplay features designed to take advantage of the Switch 2 hardware. Includes single-player modes and local and online multiplayer.
games.notes: Nintendo Switch 2

games.name: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
games.description: A standalone expansion to Marvel's Spider-Man set in a snow-covered Harlem at Christmas. Miles Morales battles the Tinkerer and the Underground gang while discovering the full extent of his new bioelectric Venom powers. Features a touching story about identity, family, and becoming a hero on your own terms.

games.name: Mass Effect: Andromeda
games.summary: RPG de science-fiction dans une galaxie inédite. Ryders explore Andromède à la recherche d'une nouvelle maison. Monde ouvert, Nomad, et relations profondes avec l'équipage du Nexus.
games.description: BioWare's action RPG set in a new galaxy, following humanity's colonists who discover the Andromeda galaxy isn't the paradise they hoped for. As the Pathfinder, explore alien planets, build relationships with crew members, and uncover the mystery of the Remnant — a vanished civilization that shaped the galaxy.

games.name: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood
games.summary: Max, the main protagonist of Max & the Magic Marker arrives home from school one day and finds his younger brother Felix playing in his room and smashing his beloved toys.
