Being annoyed by his little brother Max searches online on the search engine website “Giggle” for a way to get rid of Felix. He immediately stumbles upon a spell which promises to make his brother disappear. Reading the spell out loud opens up a mysterious portal from which a giant claw emerges and kidnaps his little brother Felix. Realizing the consequences of his actions, Max jumps without hesitation into the portal to rescue Felix and enters a magical and hostile world controlled by the evil lord Mustacho and his henchmen.
games.description: In its core Max: The Curse of Brotherhood is a physics-based puzzle/platformer and set in a 2.5D environment with a free and cinematic camera. The game has 7 chapters and 20 levels in total All levels are connected so the game feels like one long journey. Besides platforming, the gameplay twist is the magic marker which introduces a creative and open approach to how puzzles can be solved. Throughout the game the magic marker will gain different powers.  The five powers are 1. Earth pillars. You...

games.name: Medal of Honor: Heroes 2
games.summary: Medal of Honor Heroes 2 is a first-person shooter game for the Wii and the PlayStation Portable. It is the 12th installment in the long-running Medal of Honor series of World War II games. Each version was built from the ground up for its respective system. The Wii version was announced at Nintendo's E3 2007 Press Conference on July 11, 2007. It may not be sold to people under 18 in Germany because of its USK rating.[2] Medal of Honor: Heroes 2 is set in World War II, starting on the Normandy beaches trying to control German bunkers and then move on to secure a village somewhere in France.  This is the second Medal of Honor game to be released for the Wii. The first was Medal of Honor: Vanguard.  To date, it is the last World War II era Medal of Honor game released.
games.description: An EA first-person shooter set in World War II, featuring Wii-exclusive motion controls that allow players to aim using the Wii Remote and nunchuk. Features a single-player campaign across multiple WWII theatres and an online multiplayer mode supporting up to 32 players.

games.name: Metroid Dread: Special Edition
games.summary: Join intergalactic bounty hunter Samus Aran in her first new 2D Metroid story in 19 years. Samus’ story continues after the events of the Metroid Fusion game when she descends upon planet ZDR to investigate a mysterious transmission sent to the Galactic Federation. The remote planet has become overrun by vicious alien lifeforms and chilling mechanical menaces. Samus is more agile and capable than ever, but can she overcome the inhuman threat stalking the depths of ZDR?
games.description: Samus Aran returns in a 2D side-scrolling action platformer, hunted across planet ZDR by a mysterious EMMI robot while her body is slowly consumed by the X parasite. The Special Edition includes a steelbook and exclusive artbook. Features tight combat, exploration, and one of the most challenging boss encounters in the series.

games.name: Monopoly
games.description: The classic Hasbro board game brought to life on PC, featuring the full rules and mechanics of Monopoly with animated tokens, AI opponents, and house rules customization. A digital adaptation of the world's most popular property trading board game, offering local multiplayer for family play.
games.notes: Jewel Case

games.name: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
games.summary: A boy named Jin discovers his Uncle Nabu using magic to spread chaos across the kingdom, turning everyone, including his brother Zeke, into animals. While trying to stop Nabu, Jin gets turned into a pig. Learning from the king's court magician, Mysticat, about a way to return everyone to normal, Jin goes on a quest to recover five animal orbs from across the kingdom. Upon doing so, however, Mysticat takes the orbs from Jin and uses them to open the gateway to the Dark Realm for his master Lord Xaros, who had been manipulating Nabu to do his bidding. Venturing into the Dark Realm, Jin confronts Xaros and, with the help of his friends and the spirits of past Wonder Boys, manages to defeat him, restoring the kingdom to normal.
games.description: A legendary game series returns with an all-new adventure! Monster Boy is a colourful side-scrolling action adventure created in cooperation with Ryuichi Nishizawa, the creator of the Wonder Boy Monster World series (Trademark of SEGA Corporation Japan).  Monster Boy is being created to bring back the enjoyment of classic games that shine by simplicity. Pure, exciting gameplay; upbeat music and smooth graphics. You'll need to overcome huge bosses, find hidden passages, discover powerful equipme...

games.name: Monster Hunter: World
games.summary: Action-RPG de chasse aux monstres colossaux dans un écosystème vivant. Traquez, affaiblissez et récoltez des ressources de bêtes élémentaires. Co-op à 4 joueurs, loop addictif et arsenal varié.
games.description: An action RPG where players hunt and craft from colossal monsters across a living, breathing ecosystem. Track and study each creature's behavior, exploit weaknesses, and forge powerful gear from harvested materials. Supports co-op for up to four hunters online, with near-endless endgame content.

games.name: Mortal Kombat 11
games.summary: Jeu de combat ultra-violent avec les icônes de la franchise MK. Système de Krypt, Fatal Blows, et une histoire complète sur la distorsion temporelle.
games.description: NetherRealm's ultra-violent fighting game featuring an all-star roster of Mortal Kombat characters battling across a story involving time travel and multiple timelines. Features brutal fatalities, the collectible Krypt, an extensive story mode, and competitive online multiplayer with regular updates.

games.name: Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate
games.description: The Ultimate Edition of Mortal Kombat 11 includes the base game plus all DLC characters and content: Kombat Pack 1 & 2, Aftermath expansion, and Mortal Kombat 11 base game. Features all guest fighters including RoboCop, Rambo, and The Joker, plus next-gen enhancements on PS5.
games.notes: Limited Edition

games.name: Moss
games.summary: Jeu de réalité virtuelle en VR. Quill, une petite souris, explore un monde fantastique miniature. Puzzle-d'aventure touchant et atmosphérique, exploité spécialement pour le PlayStation VR.
games.description: A VR adventure game where Quill, a small brave mouse, embarks on a journey through a miniature fantasy world to rescue her uncle from the Arcane. Players take the role of a giant Reader who accompanies and guides Quill, solving environmental puzzles and engaging in third-person combat while bonding with the tiny hero.

games.name: MotorStorm
games.description: A PS3 launch racing game featuring off-road vehicles racing across treacherous terrain in six exotic global locations. Known for its stunning visuals that showcased the PS3's power at launch, destructible environments, and fast-paced extreme racing through mud, snow, and jungle environments.

games.name: MotorStorm Pacific Rift
games.description: The sequel to MotorStorm, set on a Pacific island with four times more vehicles, a dynamic weather system, and vastly improved track design. Features eight unique vehicle classes, up to 16 players online, and a destructible environment that changes throughout each race.

games.name: NBA 2K21
games.summary: With exciting improvements upon its best-in-class gameplay, competitive and community online features, and deep, varied game modes, NBA 2K21 offers one-of-a-kind immersion into all facets of NBA basketball and culture - where Everything is Game. In NBA 2K21, new, old, and returning ballers alike will find exciting game modes that offer a variety of basketball experiences.
games.description: The PS4 version of NBA 2K21, the annual basketball simulation franchise by Visual Concepts. Features MyCareer story mode, Ultimate Team-style MyTeam, and realistic gameplay simulation of NBA basketball. Represents the last-gen version before the PS5 upgrade.

games.name: NBA 2K21
games.description: The PS5 version of NBA 2K21, featuring next-gen enhancements including improved player models, City mode replacing the Neighborhood, haptic feedback, and faster load times. Includes MyCareer, MyTeam, and an all-new open-world City hub with expanded social activities.

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. U + New Super Luigi U
games.description: A Wii U bundle containing New Super Mario Bros. U and its standalone expansion New Super Luigi U. Both are side-scrolling 2D platformers with four-player co-op, featuring 100+ courses spanning eight worlds. New Super Luigi U features shorter, harder levels with Luigi's distinctive floaty jump.

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe
games.summary: Bowser’s gang has taken over Princess Peach’s Castle! This time, the goal of the journey is Peach’s occupied castle!
games.description: New Super Mario Bros. U including New Super Luigi U. for the Nintendo Switch!

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
games.summary: Today is Princess Peach’s birthday, so her castle is full of presents. Mario and Luigi are there, and they’re celebrating with the Toads and Princess Peach when a huge birthday cake arrives. Who in the world could it be from?  Suddenly, Bowser Jr. and minions jump out of the cake. Everyone is shocked and pandemonium ensues. In a flash, the invaders snatch Princess Peach and fly away in a giant Airship.  The Toads are in a panic! Mario and Luigi—and Yellow Toad, Blue Toad and Yoshi too!—pursue the Airship in order to rescue Princess Peach.  Together, the four head out on an adventurous journey!
games.description: New Super Mario Bros. Wii is a side-scrolling 2.5D Mario platformer for the Wii and the tenth game in the Super Mario series. In addition to the single-player experience, New Super Mario Bros. Wii also features a multiplayer mode for up to four players. This is the first Super Mario game to feature co-op and vs. modes at the same time since Mario Bros. It features more items, new levels, and more enemies than the DS predecessor. The game introduces two new power-ups, the Propeller Mushroom and ...

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
games.summary: Today is Princess Peach’s birthday, so her castle is full of presents. Mario and Luigi are there, and they’re celebrating with the Toads and Princess Peach when a huge birthday cake arrives. Who in the world could it be from?  Suddenly, Bowser Jr. and minions jump out of the cake. Everyone is shocked and pandemonium ensues. In a flash, the invaders snatch Princess Peach and fly away in a giant Airship.  The Toads are in a panic! Mario and Luigi—and Yellow Toad, Blue Toad and Yoshi too!—pursue the Airship in order to rescue Princess Peach.  Together, the four head out on an adventurous journey!
games.description: New Super Mario Bros. Wii is a side-scrolling 2.5D Mario platformer for the Wii and the tenth game in the Super Mario series. In addition to the single-player experience, New Super Mario Bros. Wii also features a multiplayer mode for up to four players. This is the first Super Mario game to feature co-op and vs. modes at the same time since Mario Bros. It features more items, new levels, and more enemies than the DS predecessor. The game introduces two new power-ups, the Propeller Mushroom and ...

games.name: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom
games.summary: Suite de Ni no Kuni. Evan Pettiwhythe renverse son royaume corrompu et fonde un nouveau royaume de paix. JRPG avec combat en temps réel, direction artistique Studio Ghibli-inspirée.
games.description: A JRPG sequel following Evan Pettiwhythe, a young king overthrown by a coup who must build a new kingdom from scratch. Features real-time combat with upgradeable Skywarden mechs, a Studio Ghibli-inspired visual style, and a sweeping story about unity, leadership, and the nature of kingdoms.
games.notes: Collector's Edition

games.name: Nintendo Land
games.summary: Nintendo Land is a fun and lively virtual theme park filled with attractions based on popular Nintendo game worlds. Explore the Nintendo Land Plaza as your Mii character, and play in park attractions featuring unique and innovative gameplay made possible by the Wii U GamePad controller. Enjoy team, competitive, and solo gameplay experiences for up to five players!
games.description: Nintendo's Wii U pack-in game featuring 12 Nintendo-themed attractions blending different gameplay styles. Play as Miis competing in Mario Chase, Luigi's Ghost Mansion, Metroid Blast, Zelda Battle Quest, and more. Designed to showcase the Wii U GamePad and local asymmetric multiplayer.

games.name: Nioh
games.summary: Action-RPG souls-like dans le Japon féodal fantastique. William, mercenaire irlandais, combat des Yokais et des samouraïs dans un système de combat profond avec postures et magie.
games.description: A souls-like action RPG set in a dark fantasy version of Sengoku-era Japan, where Irish sailor William Adams battles Yokai supernatural creatures alongside human samurai. Features deep stance-based combat with high, mid, and low postures, Ki Pulse mechanics, and relentless enemies demanding mastery of its complex systems.

games.name: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: Révolution 3D de la franchise. Link voyage entre passé et futur pour collecter les Médaillons des Sages et vaincre Ganondorf. Premier Zelda en 3D, considéré parmi les meilleurs jeux de l'histoire.
games.description: The game that revolutionized 3D action-adventure games. Link travels between his childhood and adult years to collect the Spiritual Stones and Medallions needed to defeat Ganondorf, who has seized the Sacred Realm. Still considered one of the greatest games ever made, scoring 99 on Metacritic.

games.name: Ocarina of Time 3D
games.summary: Remaster d'Ocarina of Time pour 3DS par GREZZO. Graphismes repensés en 3D stéréoscopique, interface améliorée, Boss Challenge ajouté. La référence ultime rendue portable.
games.description: A remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo 3DS, featuring completely redesigned graphics in stereoscopic 3D, streamlined UI, Gyroscope aiming, and a new Master Quest and Boss Challenge mode. The 3DS version makes the greatest game ever made even more accessible without compromising its landmark design.

games.name: Oddworld: Soulstorm - Day 1 Oddition
games.summary: Abe's epic story explodes in this all new adventure.  Oddworld: Soulstorm is an explosive action adventure game complete with crafting, scavenging, platforming, and sneaking. It’s the story of an impossible flight against an opposing force that will use every means at their well-funded disposal, from propaganda to brutal force to deadly violence, to stop Abe and the uprising.  You play as Abe, a reluctant hero who inadvertently sparked an uprising and now must lead his fellow Mudokons in their fight for freedom against the Magog Cartel and the planet’s ruling power.  Whether he is ready for it or not, the entire fate of the Mudokon species rests on Abe's actions. Accept his destiny and galvanize societal change, or fail and see his entire race eradicated, the choice is in your hands.
games.description: Abe is not the typical hero you would expect. He does not carry weapons, nor is he trained in any martial art. Yet he will have to face an impossible threat from increasingly violent and manipulative powers that will try to destroy him and his race.  The Oddworld: Soulstorm Day One Oddition includes Oddworld: Soulstorm and one exclusive embossed metal case.

games.name: Okami HD
games.summary: Remaster HD du jeu culte d'Amaterasu, déesse-soleil sous forme de loup blanc. Peintures célestes, direction artistique japonaise unique, aventure mythologique inoubliable.
games.description: The HD remaster of the 2006 PS2/Wii classic. Play as Amaterasu, the Japanese sun goddess in the form of a white wolf, using the Celestial Brush — painting strokes onto the world to restore beauty, grow flowers, and defeat evil. Features a unique Japanese watercolor art style and an unforgettable adventure.

games.name: Oracle of Ages
games.summary: Oracle of Ages est un Action-RPG développé par Capcom pour Game Boy Color. Link voyage dans le temps pour sauver Labrynna des plans de la Sorcière Veran.
games.description: Link travels through time in the land of Labrynna to rescue the Oracle of Ages, Nayru, from the Sorceress of Shadows. One of two interconnected Oracle games developed by Capcom; completing both reveals a secret ending involving Ganon. Features a rich world with temporal puzzles across two eras.

games.name: Oracle of Seasons
games.summary: Oracle of Seasons est un Action-RPG développé par Capcom pour Game Boy Color. Link doit obtenir l'Essence des Saisons pour libérer Holodrum des griffes du Général Onox.
games.description: Link must restore the four seasons in the land of Holodrum by recovering the Rod of Seasons from General Onox who has captured the Oracle Din. One of two interconnected Oracle games; completing both reveals a secret ending. Features a world where controlling the seasons transforms the environment and reveals new paths.

games.name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
games.summary: The little spirit Ori is no stranger to peril, but when a fateful flight puts the owlet Ku in harm’s way, it will take more than bravery to bring a family back together, heal a broken land, and discover Ori’s true destiny. From the creators of the acclaimed action-platformer Ori and the Blind Forest comes the highly anticipated sequel. Embark on an all-new adventure in a vast world filled with new friends and foes that come to life in stunning, hand-painted artwork. Set to a fully orchestrated original score, Ori and the Will of the Wisps continues the Moon Studios tradition of tightly crafted platforming action and deeply emotional storytelling.
games.description: The stunning sequel to Ori and the Blind Forest. Ori embarks on a sweeping adventure to heal the dying forest of Niwen, encountering new friends and enemies across beautifully animated environments. Features precise platforming, metroidvania exploration, combat, and one of the most visually breathtaking games ever made.

games.name: Overcooked! + Overcooked! 2
games.summary: Bundle des deux jeux de cuisine coopérative. Coordonnez-vous avec vos amis pour préparer des plats dans des cuisines chaotiques. Excellents pour jouer en famille ou entre amis.
games.description: A bundle of two chaotic cooperative cooking games. In Overcooked (Ghost Town Games), teams must prepare and serve meals across bizarre kitchens. Overcooked 2 (Team17) adds new mechanics including throwing ingredients. Both are beloved local co-op party games requiring communication and teamwork under intense pressure.

games.name: Paperboy
games.description: A port of the classic 1984 Midway arcade game. Deliver newspapers by bicycle across suburban streets, avoiding obstacles and hostile residents while hitting mailboxes. A short, challenging arcade experience with old-school charm. The NES version was developed by Mindscape and released in 1990.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). GameFAQs user reviews mixed (3–9/10). Arcade original scored 85% avg on MobyGames. NES port considered a decent but simplified version.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Action-RPG isométrique en accès anticipé. Path of Exile 2 est la suite du célèbre ARPG de Grinding Gear Games, avec une nouvelle campagne en 6 actes, de nouvelles classes et un système de progression profondément remanié.
games.description: The early access sequel to Path of Exile, featuring a completely new six-act campaign, 12 new character classes, and a reworked passive skill tree. Grinding Gear Games delivers a darker, more deliberate take on the action RPG formula with demanding combat, extraordinary build depth, and a sprawling endgame.

games.name: Phantom Hourglass
games.summary: Suite de Wind Waker sur DS. Link parcourt l'Océan fantôme sur le bateau-fantôme avec le Capitaine Linebeck. Première utilisation du stylet pour les combats et la navigation.
games.description: A Zelda adventure set on the Ocean Realm following Wind Waker, where Link sails a phantom ship with Captain Linebeck to rescue Tetra. The first Zelda to use the DS stylus exclusively for both movement and combat, with clever dungeon design centered around the touch screen.

games.name: PlayStation VR Worlds
games.summary: Collection de mini-jeux VR pour PlayStation VR. Découvrez les possibilités du casque avec des expériences variées : fond de l'océan, sauvetage en hélicoptère, film interactif et combat spatial.
games.description: A collection of five short VR experiences designed to showcase the PlayStation VR headset's capabilities. Includes Ocean Descent — an underwater shark encounter, Dangerball — a VR sports game, Scavenger's Odyssey, The London Heist, and VR Luge, offering a variety of impressions of what VR can deliver.

games.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 2018
games.summary: Simulation de football Pro Evolution Soccer avec les meilleures licences de clubs européens. ML, édition Copa Libertadores, édition FIFA et Master League profonde. Alternative plus technique à FIFA.
games.description: Konami's football simulation featuring more tactical and realistic gameplay compared to FIFA, with strong European club licenses and Master League career mode. Pro Evo 2018 is considered one of the best entries in the series, offering precise ball physics, individual player animations, and deep tactical customization.

games.name: Professor Layton and the Azran Legacy
games.summary: Race across the globe to stop the ancient Azran legacy from ending the world.
games.description: The final chapter of the prequel trilogy. Professor Layton and his team travel the globe to uncover the secrets of the ancient Azran civilization and prevent a catastrophic legacy from destroying the world. The last main-line game with Layton as the protagonist.
games.dlc: Daily downloadable puzzles via Nintendo eShop (servers offline)

games.name: Professor Layton and the Curious Village
games.summary: Solve the mystery of the Golden Apple in the eccentric village of St. Mystere.
games.description: Professor Layton and his young apprentice Luke travel to the eccentric village of St. Mystere, where they must uncover the secret of the legendary Golden Apple left behind by Baron Augustus Reinhold. The village is filled with puzzle-loving locals, and every mystery brings them one step closer to the truth.
games.dlc: 26 weekly downloadable puzzles via Nintendo Wi-Fi (service ended)

games.name: Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box
games.summary: Investigate the deadly Elysian Box aboard a mysterious luxury train.
games.description: Professor Layton and Luke board a luxury train bound for the mystical town of Folsense to investigate the Elysian Box — a relic rumored to kill anyone who opens it. The second installment in the series, featuring cross-country puzzle-solving aboard a rolling mystery.
games.dlc: Weekly downloadable puzzles via Nintendo Wi-Fi (service ended)

games.name: Professor Layton and the Last Specter
games.summary: Prequel — how Layton and Luke first met, investigating a haunting specter.
games.description: A prequel to the original trilogy. Layton receives a letter from his childhood friend about a mysterious specter haunting the town of Misthallery. This game reveals how Professor Layton and Luke first met, and introduces Emmy Altava as a new companion.
games.dlc: London Life bonus RPG mode; weekly downloadable puzzles via Nintendo Wi-Fi (service ended)

games.name: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask
games.summary: Unmask the Masked Gentleman causing miracles and mayhem in Monte d'Or.
games.description: The first Professor Layton game on Nintendo 3DS. A Masked Gentleman causes miraculous yet deadly events in the desert city of Monte d'Or. Layton investigates while flashbacks reveal his own past as a young student — and a terrible secret he has kept for years.
games.dlc: Daily downloadable puzzles via Nintendo eShop (servers offline)

games.name: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask Plus
games.description: An enhanced version of Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask available exclusively on the Nintendo eShop in Japan. Includes all the content of the original game plus additional puzzles and cutscenes. The same Layton adventure set in Monte d'Or, investigating the Masked Gentleman's miraculous and deadly tricks.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary: A new Layton puzzle adventure set in a steampunk American town — the long-awaited next chapter in the beloved series.
games.description: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is an upcoming puzzle/fantasy adventure game set one year after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future. The story takes place in Steam Bison, an American town with a steampunk aesthetic. Puzzles are designed in collaboration with QuizKnock.

games.name: Professor Layton and the Unwound Future
games.summary: Travel through time to stop a criminal empire threatening future London.
games.description: A mysterious letter sent from the future warns Professor Layton of an imminent threat to London. Layton and Luke journey through time to uncover secrets from the professor's past and face his toughest opponent yet. The emotional conclusion to the original trilogy.
games.dlc: Weekly downloadable puzzles via Nintendo Wi-Fi (service ended)

games.name: Puyo Puyo Tetris
games.summary: "Two puzzle game juggernauts collide as Tetris, one of the largest-selling and recognized brands in gaming history, and Puyo Puyo from SEGA have combined to create a fun-to-play, fast-paced, competitive party game like no other! The game has tons of different styles of gameplay – from the single-player Adventure and Challenge modes to the ferocious competition of the up-to-four player Arcade modes. There's plenty of Tetris/Puyo variety, even an in-game Shop where players can unlock new characters, new skins for Puyos and Tetriminos, new backgrounds and more."
games.description: A mashup of two legendary puzzle games — Puyo Puyo and Tetris — in one package. Switch between the two game modes in an entertaining adventure, or play in competitive modes where players can face off using either game type. Features online and local multiplayer for up to four players.

games.name: Rabbids Go Home
games.summary: A comedy adventure. To the moon or bust! The Rabbids need stuff...lots of stuff! So grab everything you can and help the Rabbids build a pile to the moon.
games.description: A Raving Rabbids spin-off where Rabbids attempt to build a rocket to the Moon using human belongings. Race through shopping malls and environments stealing objects with Verminators. Features inventive humor, diverse gameplay sections, and a memorable anti-hero premise that gives the Rabbids their most fleshed-out adventure.

games.name: Rage 2
games.summary: FPS post-apocalyptique coloré et frénétique. Dans un désert radioactif de 2185, combinez armes, pouvoirs nanotrites et véhicules pour anéantir les factions rivales dans un monde ouvert.
games.description: A colorful, anarchic open-world FPS set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Combine Avalanche Studios' open-world expertise with id Software's gunplay in a neon-drenched desert where Rangers battle mutant gangs and fascist armies. Fast movement, powerful weapons, and a relentless pace across a vibrant open world.

games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
games.summary: Aventure platformer sci-fi exclusive PS5. Ratchet et Rivet voyagent entre dimensions grâce à une fissure dimensionnelle. SSD ultra-rapide pour des changements de monde instantanés, graphismes next-gen.
games.description: An action-platformer exclusive to PS5 where Ratchet and Lombax warrior Rivet hop between dimensions thanks to a fractured Dimensionator. Showcases the PS5's SSD with instant dimension-jumping, ray tracing, DualSense haptics, and 60fps gameplay across richly detailed alien planets.

games.name: Rayman Legends: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Rayman Legends takes full advantage of the Nintendo Switch and its new controllers capabilities. Undock your Switch device and use the touch screen to take out enemies, manipulate platforms, cut ropes to clear a path and much more. With the gyroscope technology, you can move rotating platform and there are many more surprises to come!
games.description: The Definitive Edition of the acclaimed 2D platformer featuring Rayman, Globox, and the Teensies across stunning hand-painted worlds. Features creative level design with musician enemies, tempo-based challenges, co-op for up to four players, and over 100 levels including remixed origins from the original game.

games.name: Resident Evil
games.summary: Le jeu fondateur du genre survival horror. Des membres de l'équipe S.T.A.R.S. sont piégés dans un manoir rempli de zombies et de créatures mutantes, fruit des expériences du mystérieux Umbrella Corp.
games.description: A PS5 version of the 1996 original Resident Evil, remade with modernized visuals and controls. The S.T.A.R.S. team is trapped in the Spencer Mansion investigating a zombie outbreak. Experience the game that invented survival horror with modern graphics while preserving the tension and classic puzzles of the original.
games.notes: Fini sur PS5 et autres consoles

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.summary: Remake de Resident Evil 3 (1999). Jill Valentine fuit Raccoon City pourchassée par Nemesis, une arme biologique implacable. Action intense et tension constante avec graphismes modernes.
games.description: A remake of Resident Evil 3 (1999) using the RE Engine. Jill Valentine flees Raccoon City while being relentlessly pursued by Nemesis, an unstoppable bio-weapon. Faster-paced and more action-oriented than the RE2 Remake, featuring Nemesis encounters and the Resistance asymmetric multiplayer mode.

games.name: Resident Evil 4
games.summary: Remake du classique RE4 de 2005. Leon Kennedy sauve la fille du président dans un village espagnol infesté de Los Ganados. Action-horreur avec mécaniques modernes et atmosphère épais.
games.description: A complete remake of the 2005 classic using the RE Engine. Leon S. Kennedy investigates a rural Spanish village to rescue the U.S. President's daughter Ashley. Maintains the original's iconic over-the-shoulder perspective while adding modern combat, expanded story, and a deeply overhauled enemy AI system.

games.name: Resident Evil 6
games.summary: RE6 mélange survival horror et action cinématographique. Leon, Chris, Jake et Ada parcourent le monde pour arrêter une nouvelle épidémie. Quatre campagnes croisées, co-op jusqu'à 2 joueurs.
games.description: A cinematic action horror game featuring four interwoven campaigns: Leon hunting a bioterrorist in Tall Oaks, Chris combating a militia in China, Jake surviving mercenary pursuit, and Ada investigating a conspiracy. More action-oriented than previous entries, with co-op for all campaigns.

games.name: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
games.summary: Version PS4 du premier RE en vue FPS. Ethan Winters explore une plantation de Louisiane pour retrouver sa femme. Même aventure cauchemardesque que la version PS5 avec graphismes légèrement inférieurs.
games.description: The first-person horror revolution for the Resident Evil series on PS4. Ethan Winters investigates a crumbling Louisiana plantation to find his missing wife Mia, encountering the cannibalistic Baker family. A bold reinvention of the franchise combining claustrophobic atmosphere with survival horror fundamentals.
games.notes: Fini sur PS4 aussi (version physique)

games.name: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard
games.summary: Premier jeu de la franchise en vue à la première personne. Ethan Winters explore une plantation isolée en Louisiane pour retrouver sa femme, tombée aux mains d'une famille cannibale infectée.
games.description: The PS5 version of Resident Evil 7, running at higher resolution and frame rate with DualSense haptic feedback support. Ethan Winters investigates a decaying Louisiana plantation to find his missing wife, confronting the terrifying Baker family in a first-person horror experience.
games.notes: Fini sur PS5 et autres consoles

games.name: Resident Evil 9
games.summary: Resident Evil 9 est le dernier opus de la série survival horror de Capcom, poursuivant l'univers de la franchise avec de nouvelles menaces biologiques et un gameplay tension-horreur.
games.description: The ninth mainline Resident Evil game, continuing Ethan Winters' story with new supernatural threats and an expanded cast. Built on the RE Engine with next-generation visuals, this entry marks a new chapter for the series featuring both familiar faces and terrifying new enemies.
games.notes: En cours sur Xbox Series X|S

games.name: Resident Evil Origins Collection
games.summary: Collection incluant les remakes HD de Resident Evil 1 et Resident Evil 0. Retour aux sources du survival horror Capcom avec graphismes améliorés, manoir Spencer et missions de prolog.
games.description: A collection containing HD remasters of Resident Evil HD Remaster and Resident Evil 0 HD Remaster. RE HD revisits the Spencer Mansion with the classic S.T.A.R.S. team, while RE 0 HD explores events just before the original game through S.T.A.R.S. medic Rebecca Chambers and prisoner Billy Coen.

games.name: Resident Evil Village (8)
games.summary: Ethan Winters part à la recherche de sa fille kidnappée dans un mystérieux village d'Europe de l'Est dominé par la terrifiante Lady Dimitrescu et d'autres seigneurs sous l'emprise de Miranda.
games.description: Ethan Winters travels to a village in Eastern Europe to find his kidnapped daughter Rose, battling the terrifying Lady Dimitrescu and her daughters alongside other monstrous lords. A gothic survival horror game blending the first-person perspective of RE7 with larger-scale environments and more action.
games.notes: Fini sur PS5 et autres consoles

games.name: Resident Evil Village: Collector's Edition
games.summary: The collector's edition comes with all the digital items from the deluxe edition, as well as the following items: - Chris Redfield figure - Artbook - Poster - Box and steelbook case - Trauma pack (same content as in the )
games.description: The Collector's Edition of Resident Evil Village, including the base game, a steelbook case, an art book, and additional physical collectibles. Features the same gothic survival horror experience as the standard edition — Ethan Winters vs. the monstrous lords of a sinister Eastern European village.

games.name: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration
games.summary: Now, after uncovering an ancient mystery, Lara must explore the most treacherous and remote regions of Siberia to find the secret of immortality before a ruthless organization known as Trinity. Lara must use her wits and survival skills, form new alliances, and ultimately embrace her destiny as the Tomb Raider. Experience high-octane action moments, conquer beautifully hostile environments, engage in brutal guerilla combat, and explore awe-inspiring deadly tombs in the evolution of survival action. In “Rise of the Tomb Raider,” Lara becomes more than a survivor as she embarks on her first Tomb Raiding expedition. PlayStation VR Support: The full “Blood Ties” story chapter can be experienced in PlayStation VR, and players choose between two control schemes. “Comfort Mode” allows players to teleport from point to point, completely eliminating any potential discomfort. Meanwhile, experienced VR users can select “Free Mode” to move and look around using the thumb sticks.  Manipulate HD relics, examine documents, and control the flashlight with the Sixaxis controller motion as you unlock the mystery of Lara’s childhood home in first-person. The immersive HD beauty of Croft Manor is perfectly suited to VR, and for the first time in franchise history, players can explore the world through Lara’s eyes.
games.description: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Celebration includes the critically acclaimed Rise of the Tomb Raider. With over 50 hours of gameplay and all-new content created to celebrate 20 years of the iconic Lara Croft. In the critically acclaimed Tomb Raider, Lara Croft was forged into a true survivor, but she glimpsed a deeper, secret world.

games.name: Sega Mega Drive & Genesis Classics
games.summary: The collection has over 50 retro classics to experience across every genre; arcade action, shooters, beat’em ups, puzzlers, old favourites and hidden gems, with a raft of modern features. These include online multiplayer, achievements, mirror modes, rewind and save states meaning players old and new should find revisiting these great games an absolute Sonic 3D Blast.
games.description: A collection of over 50 classic Mega Drive and Genesis games including Sonic the Hedgehog, Streets of Rage 2, Golden Axe, Shining Force, Ecco the Dolphin, and many more. Features online multiplayer for select titles, challenges, achievements, and the ability to save anywhere in any game.

games.name: Shantae: Half-Genie Hero - Ultimate Day One Edition
games.summary: Iconic genie Shantae is back in her most thrilling adventure yet! The award-winning series levels-up to stunning heights thanks to an eye-popping new graphical style and incredible new game features. Transform into different creatures, dance through dynamic, danger-filled stages, complete quests for friends and face-off against awesome screen-filling bosses in a 2D platformer without equal.
games.description: The Ultimate Day One Edition of Shantae: Half-Genie Hero, an action-platformer starring the half-genie Shantae who transforms into animals using her magical hair whip. Features vibrant hand-drawn visuals, multiple unlockable modes, and DLC character campaigns including Risky Boots, Sky, and Bolo.

games.name: The Simpsons Cartoon Studio
games.description: A 1996 PC software title by Fox Interactive that let users create their own Simpsons-style animated cartoons using characters, backgrounds, and sound clips from the show. More of a creative tool than a traditional game, it allowed fans to direct their own short episodes starring Homer, Bart, and the Springfield cast.
games.notes: No Metacritic critic score available. Metacritic page exists but shows TBD. MobyGames critics: 72% avg (4 reviews). GameFAQs user reviews: 8/10 — fun cartoon creation tool. Not really a game, more of a creative software.

games.name: Skyward Sword
games.summary: Préquel ultime de la série. Link et Zelda étudient à l'Académie de Kélia, flottant dans les nuages. Première utilisation du Wii MotionPlus pour les combats à l'épée. Intro de Fi et de la Légende de Skyloft.
games.description: The ultimate prequel to the Zelda timeline. Link and Zelda study at Skyloft Academy, floating above the clouds, before a dark fate descends on Hyrule. Introduced precise MotionPlus sword controls, the Stamina Gauge, and the relationship between Link and Zelda at the heart of the entire franchise.

games.name: Skyward Sword HD
games.summary: Remaster HD de Skyward Sword pour Switch. Contrôles repensés pour le mode portable (boutons) et en ajout d'un mode 60fps. Même aventure que l'original Wii de 2011, boostée en résolution.
games.description: An HD remaster of Skyward Sword for Nintendo Switch, featuring redesigned button controls for handheld play, 60fps performance, a revised amiibo Wolf Link function, and quality-of-life improvements. Makes the Wii's acclaimed prequel accessible to players without Wii MotionPlus controllers.

games.name: Sonic Mania Plus
games.summary: Retour aux sources de Sonic en 2D avec graphismes HD pixel-art. Niveaux classiques réimaginés et nouveaux. Vitesse, bonus cachés, mode versus. La renaissance du Sonic classique selon les fans.
games.description: A love letter to the classic 16-bit Sonic games, developed by Christian Whitehead and Headcannon with Sega's blessing. Features reimagined classic zones alongside all-new ones, the return of Mighty and Ray as playable characters, a competitive Encore Mode, and pixel-perfect classic Sonic gameplay.

games.name: Sonic Superstars
games.summary: Platformer 2D avec Sonic, Amy, Tails et Knuckles. Retour aux bases avec défis de taille réduite et exploration nécessaire pour progresser. Mode Coop local, graphismes colorés et vitesse Sonic.
games.description: A 2D platformer featuring Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy Rose across new zones filled with hidden paths and collectibles. Introduces the cooperative Trip the Sungazer character and a new boss structure. Designed as an accessible return to classic 2D Sonic with modern production values.

games.name: Spirit Tracks
games.summary: Suite de Phantom Hourglass sur DS. Link voyage en train à travers le Nouveau Monde avec le fantôme de Zelda pour empêcher Malladus de s'emparer du réel. Dernière aventure du Link de Wind Waker.
games.description: A sequel to Phantom Hourglass set in the land of New Hyrule, where Link and the ghost of Princess Zelda ride the Spirit Train to defeat the Demon King Malladus. Features the DS stylus for movement and combat, and a train-riding overworld replacing the ship from its predecessor.

games.name: Splatoon
games.description: Nintendo's landmark third-person shooter that introduced the Splatoon universe. Inklings battle for territory using colorful ink in competitive multiplayer matches. The first Splatoon established the franchise's unique mechanics, charming aesthetic, and the series' signature Turf War and ranked online modes.

games.name: Splatoon 2
games.summary: Splatoon 2 is a multiplayer third-person shooter in which players control characters known as Inklings and use colored ink to attack opponents and clear goals. Inklings can alternate between humanoid form, during which they can fire ink with their weapons, and squid form, which allows them to swim through ink of their own color in order to move quickly and replenish ink supplies.
games.description: The Nintendo Switch sequel to Splatoon, expanding the Turf War formula with new weapons, a story-driven Octo Expansion DLC, and Salmon Run cooperative horde mode. Features a vibrant cast, ongoing Splatfests, and refined competitive multiplayer that made Splatoon 2 one of Switch's most-played titles.

games.name: Star Wars
games.summary: This game is based entirely on the first Star Wars movie, Episode IV: A New Hope. The opening of the game features an animated cinematic of the opening scene of the film. After that the player takes control of Luke Skywalker, driving the landspeeder across Tatooine in search of R2-D2.    Luke Skywalker explores various locations throughout Tatooine, fighting numerous enemies including Jawas and Stormtroopers. The game features many locations from the movie including the Chalmun's Cantina in Mos Eisley where Luke meets Han Solo for the first time. This section of the game features a classic 8-bit rendition of the "Cantina Band" theme as played by the fictitious band, Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes, in the feature film. The game also contains many famous lines from the movie including Obi-Wan Kenobi's plea to Luke to join him in his trip to Alderann and Han Solo's description of the smell from the Death Star's trash compactor.    The player eventually lands on the Death Star and has to destroy the tractor beam to escape. The game also features first person segments of piloting the Millenium Falcon through that Asteroid field that was once Alderaan, and shooting down Tie Fighters in both the Millenium Falcon and an X-Wing fighter. The finale of the game features a top down view of Luke Skywalker's X-Wing flying through the Death Star trenches. After the player successfully fires a torpedo into the Death Star's exposed exhaust port, a cinematic of the Death Star exploding and Luke Skywalker being awarded a medal on Yavin IV is shown.    The game featured the characters Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Princess Leia, R2-D2, and C-3PO. The game however does not feature Darth Vader or Chewbacca, both of whom are major characters in the film.
games.description: A NES port of the Star Wars arcade game, loosely based on the 1977 film. Players guide Luke Skywalker through platform levels and space battles, fighting enemies from the original trilogy. One of the earliest Star Wars games, notable for using music and sound from the film.
games.notes: No Metacritic score (pre-Metacritic era). Mixed reception — praised for variety (landspeeder, Millennium Falcon sections) but criticized for high difficulty and loose controls. GameFAQs reviews: 5–8/10.

games.name: Star Wars Battlefront
games.summary: FPS multijoueur se déroulant pendant la Guerre des Étoiles originale. Batailles sur Hoth, Endor, Jakku. Grandes batailles en ligne jusqu'à 40 joueurs avec véhicules iconiques de l'univers SW.
games.description: DICE's multiplayer shooter set in the original Star Wars trilogy era. Battle on iconic planets including Hoth, Endor, and Jakku in large-scale infantry and vehicle combat. Features the Supremacy, Walker Assault, and Blast modes, with hero characters like Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker available as power-ups.

games.name: Star Wars Battlefront II
games.summary: Suite de Star Wars Battlefront avec une campagne solo. Iden Versio, officier impériale, traverse l'ère de la Trilogie Originale à la Nouvelle Trilogie. Multi-éres, classes et cartes galactiques.
games.description: The sequel to Star Wars Battlefront features a story campaign following Imperial officer Iden Versio across all three Star Wars eras, plus expanded multiplayer with space battles, reinforcements, and an expanded heroes roster including prequel and sequel era characters.

games.name: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order
games.summary: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order is a narratively driven, single-player game puts you in the role of a Jedi Padawan who narrowly escaped the purge of Order 66 following the events of Episode III: Revenge of the Sith. On a quest to rebuild the Jedi Order, you must pick up the pieces of your shattered past to complete your training, develop new powerful Force abilities and master the art of the iconic lightsaber - all while staying one step ahead of the Empire and its deadly Inquisitors.
games.description: A third-person action game by Respawn Entertainment set in the Star Wars universe, following Cal Kestis, a Jedi Padawan who survived Order 66. Combines lightsaber combat inspired by souls games with Force powers, puzzle-solving, and a narrative about rebuilding the Jedi Order.

games.name: Steep: Road to the Olympics
games.summary: Steep Road to the Olympics takes you on a journey to the Olympic Winter Games PyeongChang 2018 in South Korea.    Freely explore a massive open world, including iconic Japanese mountains, where you will train hard and take part in qualifiers to reach the ultimate winter sports competition.    Create your own success story as you pull off awesome tricks in freestyle sports, or challenge yourself in new full-speed alpine action. Show other players what you’re made of and go for the gold!    Steep Road to the Olympics is an Official Licensed Product of the Olympic Winter Games PyeongChang 2018.
games.description: An extreme sports game set in the Alps and featuring the 2018 PyeongChang Olympics. Shred mountains via snowboard, ski, wingsuit, paraglide, and snowmobile across a vast open mountain world. Road to the Olympics adds official Olympic disciplines across multiple disciplines in a story-driven mode.

games.name: Strange Brigade
games.summary: Shooter coop à 4 joueurs dans l'Égypte des années 1930. Une brigade d'aventuriers combat des morts-vivants et des cultistes. Ton pulp et aventurier, excellente exprience multi locale.
games.description: A cooperative third-person shooter set in 1930s Egypt where four adventurers battle the undead and cultists. Choose between stealth and action approaches through increasingly dangerous scenarios. Features local and online co-op for up to four players and a campy adventure tone reminiscent of pulp serials.

games.name: Streets of Rage 4: Signature Edition
games.summary: Ten years have passed since the fall of Mr. X and his Syndicate. The city has been at peace... until now. A new crime empire has arisen, corrupting everything good in the city. It is rumored to be led by Mr. X's own children: the Y Twins.  Former detectives Axel Stone and Blaze Fielding join forces with their old friend's daughter, Cherry Hunter, along with Floyd Iraia, an apprentice of the brilliant Dr. Zan.  Together these four vigilantes stand against the Y Syndicate on the... Streets of Rage.
games.description: Streets of Rage 4 is an all-new continuation of the iconic arcade brawler series known for its radical fights, jammin’ ‘90s beats and dashing sparring gloves and bandanas. The Streets of Rage 4: Signature Edition includes a region free copy of the base game, five limited edition enamel pins, a numbered collector’s certificate, Axel Stone's blue bandana, and the 2 CD full original soundtrack, as well as being packaged in a sturdy “Sierra” box with outer sleeve.

games.name: Super Bomberman R Online
games.summary: Drop bombs and collect power-ups to blast your way through SUPER BOMBERMAN R ONLINE! You can compete against up to 64 players from around the world in this explosive survival battle. With the new BATTLE 64 mode, move from one area to another and blast away your rivals in an epic online survival battle! Fight your way to the end and outlast all other players to be BOMBER ONE!
games.description: An online battle royale Bomberman game for up to 64 players. Fight in a shrinking arena, collect power-ups, and be the last Bomber standing. Also includes the Grand Prix mode with up to 8 players online and offline. Features crossplay and familiar Bomberman mechanics in a competitive format.

games.name: Super Mario 3D All-Stars
games.summary: Discover three of Mario’s grandest 3D adventures with Super Mario 3D All-Stars on Nintendo Switch! This special bundle includes Super Mario 64, Super Mario Sunshine and Super Mario Galaxy, all optimized for Nintendo Switch with updated HD graphics, Joy-Con controls, as well as a music player featuring the epic soundtracks from all three games!
games.description: A limited-edition compilation celebrating Super Mario's 35th anniversary, including Super Mario 64, Super Mario Sunshine, and Super Mario Galaxy in upgraded form for Nintendo Switch. Features improved resolutions and frame rates for the classic 3D platformers, released for a limited time in 2020-2021.

games.name: Super Mario 3D World
games.summary: While having a walk in the Mushroom Kingdom, Mario, Toad and Peach, and Luigi happen on one of the many green pipes, yet a special one. A fairy, which they'll learn is Princess Sprixie, comes out. Bowser is chasing after her, though: he kidnaps her and vanishes through the pipe. Mario and the friends of his can't but promptly jump into the pipe, and they find themselves in the Sprinxie Kingdom, tasked with rescuing the princess.
games.description: Super Mario 3D World is a 3D platformer action game for the Wii U, and a follow-up of the Nintendo 3DS installment Super Mario 3D Land. The game builds upon the previous installment, following a similar 3D level-design convention inspired from the 2D platformer titles where players must navigate through a linear-designed level within a time limit to reach a level's Goal Pole. One key aspect introduced in this title is the simultaneous multiplayer: while not the first game in the series to do so...

games.name: Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury
games.summary: The Super Mario 3D World + Bowser’s Fury game features the same lively co-op gameplay, creative levels and power-ups as the original game, but with added improvements. In the Super Mario 3D World part of the game, characters move faster and the dash powers up more quickly. Both adventures support the newly added Snapshot Mode, pause the action to get the perfect shot, apply filters, and decorate with stamps!
games.description: An enhanced Nintendo Switch port of the acclaimed Wii U platformer, featuring smoother 60fps performance and the new Bowser's Fury mode. In the main game, Mario and friends traverse themed 3D worlds. Bowser's Fury is a standalone open-world adventure against a kaiju-sized Bowser Fury.

games.name: Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury
games.summary: The Super Mario 3D World + Bowser’s Fury game features the same lively co-op gameplay, creative levels and power-ups as the original game, but with added improvements. In the Super Mario 3D World part of the game, characters move faster and the dash powers up more quickly. Both adventures support the newly added Snapshot Mode, pause the action to get the perfect shot, apply filters, and decorate with stamps!
games.description: An enhanced Nintendo Switch port of the acclaimed Wii U platformer, featuring smoother 60fps performance and the new Bowser's Fury mode. In the main game, Mario and friends traverse themed 3D worlds. Bowser's Fury is a standalone open-world adventure against a kaiju-sized Bowser Fury.

games.name: Super Mario 64 DS
games.summary: Answering an invitation, Mario, Luigi and Wario set out for a royal party with Princess Peach. When they arrive at the castle, though, they find it strangely empty. Meanwhile, Yoshi awakes from a rooftop nap to find the castle eerily silent, with Mario, Luigi and Wario nowhere to be seen. Yoshi soon discovers that Bowser has pilfered the castle's Power Stars and imprisoned the Toads in the castle's immense collection of paintings. It's up to the dynamic dino to figure out what happened to Mario, Luigi and Wario and save the day.
games.description: Super Mario 64, the classic 3D platformer for the Nintendo 64, arrives on the Nintendo DS with all-new features that take advantage of the portable system's dual screens, touch screen, and wireless multiplayer capability. Like the original game, Super Mario 64 DS challenges you to find all the power stars hidden throughout the royal castle in the effort to free Peach imprisoned inside the castle. This time, you can play as Mario, Luigi, Wario, and Yoshi, each of whom has unique abilities. Overc...

games.name: Super Mario Bros. 2
games.summary: One evening, Mario had a strange dream. He dreamt of a long, long stairway leading up to a door. As soon as the door opened, he was confronted with a world he had never seen before spreading out as far as his eyes could see. When he strained his ears to listen, he heard a faint voice saying, "Welcome to Subcon, the land of dreams. We have been cursed by Wart and we are completely under his evil spell. We have been awaiting your arrival. Please defeat Wart and return Subcon to its natural state. The curse Wart has put on you in the real world will not have any effect upon you here. Remember, Wart hates vegetables. Please help us!"  At the same time this was heard, a bolt of lightning flashed before Mario’s eyes. Stunned, Mario lost his footing and tumbled upside down. He awoke with a start to find himself sitting up in his bed. To clear his head, Mario talked to Luigi, Toad and Princess Peach about the strange dream he had. They decided to go to a nearby mountain for a picnic.  After arriving at the picnic area and looking at the scenery, they see a small cave nearby. When they enter this cave, to their great surprise, there’s a stairway leading up, up and up. It is exactly like the one Mario saw in his dream. They all walk together up the stairs and at the top, find a door just like the one in Mario’s dream. When Mario and his friends, in fear, open the door, to their surprise, the world that he saw in his dream spreads out before them!
games.description: Super Mario Bros. 2, 2D platformer and sequel to Super Mario Bros. (1985), features 4 selectable characters (Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Toad) as they navigate the dream world of Subcon to defeat the evil toad king Wart. Super Mario Bros. 2 features different ways interacting with enemies and the world, including an object carrying mechanic and more intricate level designs.
games.notes: No Metacritic score for original NES version (pre-Metacritic era). GameFAQs user avg: 'Great' (3.6/5). Considered a classic NES platformer despite being a reskin of Yume Kōjō: Doki Doki Panic.

games.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
games.summary: Platformer 2D Nintendo avec la mécanique Badge inédite. Mario et ses amis traversent le Royaume Fleur en utilisant des Badges Wonder qui transforment radicalement chaque niveau.
games.description: The first new 2D Mario in over a decade, featuring the Wonder Flower mechanic that transforms each level in unexpected ways. Explore the Flower Kingdom as Mario and friends in sidescrolling levels full of surprises, creativity, and hidden secrets. Features online co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Super Mario Galaxy
games.summary: Every hundred years, a huge comet flies by in the skies above the Mushroom Kingdom. One year, that comet filled the entire sky, and from it fell a stream of shooting stars. The Toads scooped up the Star Bits and brought them to the castle, where they were reborn as a great Power Star. It was a happy time in the Mushroom Kingdom. Then one night Mario received a letter...  “Dear Mario, I’ll be waiting for you at the castle on the night of the Star Festival. There’s something I’d like to give you. from Peach”  With invitation in hand, Mario headed off to the castle just as the Star Festival was getting into full swing. Surrounded by Toads gleefully trying to catch falling Star Bits, Mario was looking forward to the night’s festivities. But then, something happened...
games.description: A 3D platformer and first Wii entry in the Super Mario franchise, Super Mario Galaxy sees Mario jump across planets and galaxies with varying items, enemies, geographies and gravity mechanics in order to reach his enemy Bowser, who has attacked the Mushroom Kingdom and hijacked Princess Peach's castle with her inside.

games.name: Super Mario Galaxy 2
games.summary: Shining stardust falls on the Mushroom Kingdom once every hundred years. That time had come again…  “Dear Mario, Would you like to share some cake while we watch the shooting stars? Meet me at the castle! Peach”  Mario ran through the field with stars falling around him. Suddenly, he noticed a strange light in the grass. As he peered cautiously through the reeds, he saw a small, lost Luma. With the baby Luma tucked safely under his cap, Mario rushed on to the castle. But when he got there, something unexpected was waiting for him…
games.description: Super Mario Galaxy 2 is the sequel to Super Mario Galaxy and the fourth 3D platformer entry in the Mario franchise. The sequel retains many elements from its predecessor, such as the adventure being in outer space, the element of gravity, and recurring objects such as Launch Stars and Sling Stars. Returning items include the Bee Mushroom and the Fire Flower. However, the game introduces new elements as well, such as the utilization of Yoshi, new power-ups like the Cloud Flower, and the use of a...

games.name: Super Mario Maker
games.summary: Super Mario Maker lets people’s imaginations run wild. For the first time ever, friends can have fun playing through levels they create for one another. The Wii U GamePad controller makes it so easy for anyone to create levels; it may feel like simply sketching out ideas on paper. Players can enjoy a seemingly endless supply of inventive Mario levels from players around the world.  The game includes a book totaling about 100 pages that illustrates the boundless possibilities in Super Mario Maker. Nintendo will also release two special Mario amiibo figures to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the original Super Mario Bros. game. Tapping these amiibo in Super Mario Maker adds a Big Mushroom power-up to your course, allowing Mario to grow big and bust blocks from any direction, as well as adding a retro visual filter to the game, reminiscent of older cathode ray tube televisions. In addition, many other amiibo will also be compatible with Super Mario Maker through the use of a new item called the Mystery Mushroom. This item allows Mario to take the appearance of many other characters, such as Link, Kirby or Wii Fit Trainer, complete with character-specific animations and sound effects. These character costumes can be unlocked by completing the 100 Mario Challenge mode and many can also be unlocked if the player taps the amiibo of the character to the Wii U GamePad.
games.description: A creative platform game where players design and share their own Mario courses. Choose from four visual styles — Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario World, and New Super Mario Bros. U — and build levels limited only by imagination. Includes a 100 Mario Challenge and online course sharing.

games.name: Super Mario Maker 2
games.summary: A side-scrolling Mario adventure that unleashes the creative potential of Super Mario Maker 2 awaits in Story Mode, which contains over 100 built-in courses. And in Course Maker, a wide range of parts, tools, and more are available so you can construct your own courses. Want coin-shooting cannons? Bowser riding on a giant Goomba? Cat Mario sliding down slopes to take out an army of baddies? Go for it! You call the shots. Pass a Joy-Con controller to a partner to build co-operatively on a single system!
games.description: The Nintendo Switch sequel to Super Mario Maker, featuring a story-driven Course World, online multiplayer in Course Bot, new game styles including Super Mario 3D World, night themes, co-op level creation, and an expanded set of tools and enemies for building and sharing Mario courses.

games.name: Super Mario Odyssey
games.summary: Explore incredible places far from the Mushroom Kingdom as you join Mario and his new ally Cappy on a massive, globe-trotting 3D adventure. Use amazing new abilities, like the power to capture and control objects, animals, and enemies to collect Power Moons so you can power up the Odyssey airship and save Princess Peach from Bowser’s wedding plans!
games.description: Mario's globe-trotting 3D platformer adventure across diverse Kingdoms from New Donk City to sand deserts and lava worlds. Using Cappy — his living hat — Mario captures enemies and objects to gain new abilities. Praised for its creativity, density of content, and joyful exploration.

games.name: Super Mario Party
games.summary: Turn the tables on opponents as you race across the board to collect the most stars in the original four-player Mario Party series board game mode. Discover 80 mini-games packed with wildly different challenges, play with others online and enjoy this full-on frenzy with family and friends!
games.description: A party game featuring Mario characters across colorful boards with four-player competition, minigames, and the new River Survival cooperative mode. Features tabletop-friendly board designs and Joy-Con motion controls for minigames, making it the first Mario Party designed from the ground up for Nintendo Switch.

games.name: Super Smash Bros. Brawl
games.summary: Super Smash Bros. Brawl is the third installment in the Super Smash Bros. series and the follow-up to Super Smash Bros. Melee. This edition introduces super attacks referred to as final smashes: activated by destroying smash balls, these feature powerful and often unstoppable attacks, regularly introducing a major transformation of the character. This edition also introduces a brand new adventure mode in The Subspace Emissary which is a side-scrolling adventure in the style of a platformer. It retains all basic mechanics of the Super Smash Bros. series, such as a damage meter, stocks, and Smash-style attacks.
games.description: The third Super Smash Bros. game, featuring the largest roster at the time with over 35 characters including Sonic and Snake. Introduced the Subspace Emissary adventure mode, the Assist Trophy system, and online multiplayer. Still beloved for its vast content, trophy collection, and Co-op gameplay.

games.name: Super Smash Bros. for Wii U
games.summary: Super Smash Bros. for Wii U is the fourth console-based entry in the popular Super Smash Bros. series of fighting games. With an even larger roster of fighters than its predecessors and the introduction eight player battles, Smash for Wii U continues to add to the formula that gamers have loved since 1999.
games.description: The fourth Super Smash Bros. for Wii U, featuring 51 playable characters, HD graphics, and 8-player Smash mode. Developed jointly with Bandai Namco Studios and Sora Ltd., it includes hundreds of trophies, custom movesets, and the most extensive content in any Smash game to that point.

games.name: Sushi Striker: The Way of Sushido
games.summary: "The ultimate food fight!  In the fast-paced world of conveyor-belt sushi fighting, match colored plates and types of sushi to hurl tall stacks of plates at your opponent. The more matches you make, the taller the plate stack and the stronger your attacks will be. Defend your homeland from invading enemies in this puzzling action game so more people can enjoy delicious sushi in peace. May the best sushi samurai reign supreme!"
games.description: A unique puzzle RPG where players match colored sushi plates to defeat enemies in rapid-fire battles. Features a story mode spanning 100+ stages, local and online multiplayer, and the quirky concept of sushi-based combat. Developed by Nintendo EPD with a colorful, fast-paced approach to the puzzle genre.

games.name: Team Sonic Racing
games.summary: Course en équipes de 3 avec les personnages Sonic, Shadow, et des alliés. Mécaniques de partage d'éléments entre coméquipiers, circuits colorés, et musiques électroniques Sonic.
games.description: A team-based kart racer featuring Sonic characters in teams of three, where sharing items and drafting benefits the whole squad. Developed by Sumo Digital, it features 21 racers, 21 tracks, and online multiplayer. The cooperative mechanic requires players to communicate and work together to win.

games.name: Tears of the Kingdom
games.summary: Suite de Breath of the Wild. Link et Zelda explorent les ruines célestes au-dessus d'Hyrule. Nouvelles capacités : Recall, Ultrahand, Infiltration, Emprise. Construction de véhicules et inventivité maximale.
games.description: The direct sequel to Breath of the Wild, set in a Hyrule where ancient Zonai ruins float in the sky above. Link gains four new abilities — Ultrahand, Recall, Ascend, and Fuse — allowing for unprecedented creativity in exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving. Scored 96 on Metacritic.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
games.summary: With Bebop and Rocksteady amassing gizmos to support Krang and Shredder’s latest scheme, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge finds the turtles battling through a breathless tour of iconic TMNT locations to thwart their nemeses’ most diabolical plan yet. Armed with shell-shocking new abilities built on a foundation of classic brawling mechanics, the gang are in for an exhilarating, Foot Clan-stomping romp leading them through the sewers and bustling boroughs of New York City all the way to Dimension X.
games.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge reunites Leonardo, Raphael, Michelangelo, and Donatello to kick shell in a beautifully realized pixel art world invoking the turtles' classic 1987 design.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
games.description: A definitive collection of 13 classic TMNT games spanning from 1989 to 2009, including the original arcade games, NES classics, Tournament Fighters, and more. Features online multiplayer for most titles, digital manuals, museum content, and full scanline/CRT filter options for authentic retro presentation.

games.name: Terminator Resistance
games.description: A first-person shooter set in a future war against Skynet, following soldier Jacob Rivers on a mission to uncover a sinister Terminator operation. Developed by Teyon, the game captures the feel of the original films with stealth and action sections across a post-apocalyptic Los Angeles battlefield.

games.name: Terminator Resistance Enhanced
games.description: The Enhanced PS5 edition of Terminator Resistance, featuring ray tracing, improved frame rate, new Infiltrator Mode, and additional story content. The base game follows soldier Jacob Rivers fighting Skynet in a post-apocalyptic LA, capturing the tone of the original Terminator films.

games.name: Test Drive Off-Road
games.description: An off-road racing game from the late 1990s featuring multiple terrain types including dirt, mud, and snow across various environments. An early PC racing title that offered accessible arcade-style off-road gameplay before the genre became more simulation-focused.
games.notes: No Metacritic critic score available. Metacritic page exists but shows TBD. GameFAQs user review: 3/10 — 'underwhelming racer.' IGN notes poor physics engine.

games.name: Tetris
games.summary: Tetris is a puzzle video game for the Game Boy released in 1989. It is a portable version of Alexey Pajitnov's original Tetris and it was bundled in the North American and European releases of the Game Boy itself. It was the first game compatible with the Game Link Cable, a pack-in accessory that allowed two Game Boys to link together for multiplayer purposes.
games.description: The classic Tetris puzzle game on Nintendo 3DS, featuring the traditional mode of stacking falling tetrominoes to clear lines. Includes Marathon, Sprint, and Ultra timed modes, as well as StreetPass and SpotPass functionality for competitive play against other 3DS owners.

games.name: Tetris 99
games.summary: A blockbuster battle royale! 99 players but only one will remain! Tetris 99 is the iconic puzzle game as you've never seen it before. Can you pick the right strategy to best 98 other players online - all at the same time?!
games.description: A battle royale take on Tetris where 99 players compete simultaneously, sending garbage lines to opponents by targeting them. Available exclusively as a Nintendo Switch Online subscriber game, Tetris 99 turns the classic puzzle game into an intense, fast-paced competitive experience.

games.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
games.summary: FPS tactique en équipes 5v5. Destructions environnementales, opérateurs uniques et gadgets variés. Le jeu de compétition en ligne de référence chez Ubisoft.
games.description: A tactical first-person shooter with destructible environments and 5v5 team play featuring unique Operators from counter-terrorism units worldwide. Each Operator has a distinct gadget changing how they breach, defend, or gather intel. Emphasis on strategy, communication, and environmental destruction makes every round unique.

games.name: Tomb Raider II
games.description: The second game in the Tomb Raider series, following Lara Croft as she hunts the legendary Dagger of Xian across Venice, China, and Tibet while battling the Fiamma Nera cult. A longer, more complex adventure than the original with expanded vehicle sections and diverse global environments.
games.notes: Metacritic: 85/100 based on 13 critic reviews (PC/PSX versions).

games.name: Trackmania Turbo
games.summary: Jeu de course arcade Trackmania sur PS4. Pistes futuristes avec sauts et loopings spectaculaires. Mode Time Attack, campagne et éditeur de circuits. Pur plaisir de conduite en piste.
games.description: An arcade racing game by Nadeo featuring cars racing on extreme tracks with loops, wall rides, and gravity-defying jumps. The Turbo edition brings the Trackmania formula to consoles with four distinct environments, Time Attack, local split-screen, and online multiplayer for up to 100 players.

games.name: Tri Force Heroes
games.summary: Aventure coopérative 3 joueurs sur 3DS. Link et ses deux clones doivent collaborer pour résoudre des puzzles dans le royaume de Hytopia. Focus multijoueur local et en ligne.
games.description: A cooperative Zelda adventure for Nintendo 3DS where Link teams up with two clones of himself to solve puzzles and explore the kingdom of Hytopia, whose inhabitants have been cursed with animal costumes. Features three-player local and online co-op as the central design mechanic.

games.name: Twilight Princess
games.summary: Zelda réaliste en cel-shading foncé sur GameCube/Wii. Link chevauche Epona à travers Hyrule enveloppé d'un Crépuscule pour sauver le royaume, avec la compagnie de Midona.
games.description: The original GameCube release of Twilight Princess. Link, a farm worker in Ordon Village, embarks on an epic quest to save Hyrule from the Twilight Realm alongside the mysterious imp Midna, transforming into a wolf in shadowed regions. Released simultaneously on Wii and GameCube, the GCube version uses traditional controls.

games.name: Twilight Princess HD
games.summary: Remaster HD de Twilight Princess pour Wii U. Graphismes en 1080p, amiibo Wolf Link inclus, nouveau donjon Cave of Shadows. L'aventure du Crépuscule dans toute sa splendeur.
games.description: The Wii U HD remaster of Twilight Princess featuring 1080p graphics, GamePad map and item management, improved amiibo support, and the Cave of Shadows challenge dungeon unlocked via the Wolf Link amiibo. An enhanced version of the 2006 masterpiece with modernized presentation.

games.name: Ultimate NES Remix
games.summary: Take on a rapid-fire onslaught of challenges and mash-ups from 16 of Nintendo’s finest 8-bit games! Test your skills on a gauntlet of quick, tricky challenges and remix stages that combine parts of different games. The best mix of titles from the NES Remix and NES Remix 2 games is on Nintendo 3DS. Now you’re playing with PORTABLE power!  Link vs. Donkey Kong! Kirby vs. Boo! It’s mash-up mania in this celebration of all things NES! Race through to earn stars on increasingly tough tasks, like beating Ridley from Metroid or making Princess Peach save herself! Compete in Championship Mode’s blitz of challenges from the Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 3, and Dr. Mario games, then compare scores with others in your region via online leaderboards*.  Features action-packed challenges from 16 classic 8-bit Nintendo games. Dominate exciting chunks of retro Nintendo games from NES Remix, such as Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda, Excitebike, and Donkey Kong. Challenges from NES Remix 2 include bite-sized chunks of Super Mario Bros. 3, Zelda II- The Adventure of Link, Metroid, Kid Icarus, and Kirby’s Adventure, among many others. Test your skills in a series of altered 8-bit challenges and improve your times to unlock more challenges! Take on 3 unique challenges from the Nintendo World Championships and Nintendo Campus Challenge, then check your score on online leaderboards* to see how you stack up. Connect to the Nintendo eShop to download full versions of your favorite classic games.
games.description: A collection of remixed and reimagined challenges from classic NES games including Super Mario Bros., Donkey Kong, Metroid, and more. Presents familiar NES gameplay in new bite-sized challenge formats, tasking players with completing modified versions of iconic moments under new conditions.

games.name: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
games.summary: Nathan Drake effectue son dernier casse à travers le monde pour retrouver un trésor légendaire. Gameplay d'action-aventure cinématographique au sommet de sa forme sur PS4.
games.description: Nathan Drake's final adventure takes him across the globe in search of Henry Avery's pirate treasure while confronting his troubled past and his complicated brother Sam. The most cinematic and emotionally resonant Uncharted, praised for its stunning set pieces, character depth, and technical achievement.

games.name: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy
games.summary: Spin-off d'Uncharted avec Chloe Frazer et Nadine Ross. Duo explosif cherche un artefact mythique en Inde. Aussi beau et bien joué que la série principale, avec un duo féminin mémorable.
games.description: A standalone Uncharted spin-off starring Chloe Frazer and Nadine Ross on a mission to find the Tusk of Ganesh in India. A tight, focused adventure that proves the Uncharted formula works brilliantly with a new duo, featuring excellent chemistry, strong character development, and signature spectacular action.

games.name: Unravel (Yarny Bundle)
games.summary: Bundle incluant Unravel et Unravel 2. Yarny, un personnage fait de fil, traverse des environnements naturels dans des puzzles-platformers émouvants et visuellement époustouflants.
games.description: A bundle containing Unravel and Unravel Two. In Unravel, Yarny — a small figure made of red yarn — explores beautiful Nordic environments solving physics-based puzzles. Unravel Two adds a second Yarny for cooperative play. Both are emotionally resonant platformers with stunning hand-crafted visuals.

games.name: Until Dawn
games.summary: Horreur interactive de Supermassive Games. Huit ados sont piégés dans un chalet montagnard. Vos décisions déterminent qui survit jusqu'à l'aube. Chaque choix peut sauver ou condamner vos amis.
games.description: Eight teenagers are trapped in a remote mountain lodge, hunted by a killer. Every decision you make determines who lives and who dies in this interactive horror from Supermassive Games. Features the Butterfly Effect system where seemingly small choices have major story consequences, with multiple possible endings.

games.name: Urban Trial Playground
games.description: An arcade motorcycle game where players perform tricks and navigate obstacle courses across urban environments. Urban Trial Playground features intuitive controls, responsive bike physics, and a variety of stunt challenges and time trials across multiple themed playgrounds for the Nintendo Switch.

games.name: Victor Vran: Overkill Edition
games.summary: The Victor Vran: Overkill Edition includes the fully updated Victor Vran, the expansive Fractured Worlds & the legendary Motörhead: Through The Ages.
games.description: An action RPG hack-and-slash set in a dark fantasy world of Zagoravia, where the demon hunter Victor Vran battles hordes of undead creatures. The Overkill Edition includes the full game plus the Fractured Worlds and Motörhead: Through the Ages DLCs, adding music-themed levels and new enemies.

games.name: Wii Party U
games.description: A party game collection for Wii U featuring board games, balloon games, and other minigame modes for the whole family. Includes Wii Party as a playful series of minigames using Miis, a 50-game tabletop and house party collection, and asymmetric GamePad gameplay for TV-Off mode.

games.name: The Wind Waker
games.summary: Zelda à la direction artistique cel-shading révolutionnaire. Link navigue sur un océan immense pour retrouver sa sœur kidnappée et affronter Ganondorf. L'un des plus beaux jeux de la GameCube.
games.description: The original GameCube release of The Wind Waker, featuring Link sailing a vast ocean to rescue his sister and defeat Ganondorf. The cel-shaded art style was divisive at launch but now considered timeless. A charming, swashbuckling Zelda with a joyful tone distinct from the rest of the series.

games.name: WipEout Omega Collection
games.summary: Collection de jeux de course futuriste WipEout en HD. Comprend WipEout HD, Fury et 2048. Vaisseaux anti-gravité à grande vitesse, bandes-son électroniques légendaires.
