games.description: A PS4 collection containing three anti-gravity racing games: WipEout HD, WipEout HD Fury, and WipEout 2048, all in one package running at 60fps in 4K on PS4 Pro. Features the iconic futuristic racing with devastating weapons and a legendary electronic music soundtrack.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.description: A souls-like action RPG set in Three Kingdoms-era China, following a militia soldier fighting against demonic creatures corrupted by the dark forces of the Five Phases. Features a morale system, martial arts combat with parries and counterattacks, and a story loosely based on the historical Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus
games.summary: FPS dans une Amérique altérative nazie des années 60. BJ Blazkowicz mène la résistance américaine avec humour noir, narration émotionnelle et action explosive déchainée.
games.description: BJ Blazkowicz leads the American resistance against a victorious Nazi regime in a 1960s alternate history America. Machine Games delivers a narrative-driven FPS with explosive dual-wielding action, memorable characters including BJ's companions, and an emotional story about resistance and hope.

games.name: Wreckfest
games.summary: Course de demolition destructible avec voitures qui se détériorent physiquement. Niveaux avec animaux, tremplins fous et contacts violents. Humour noir, courses chaotiques et fun garanti.
games.description: A demolition derby racing game with advanced car damage simulation, where vehicles visibly deform and lose parts throughout races. Features a chaotic mix of circuit races, arena battles, and destruction events across creative venues. Known for its satisfying physics and dark humor.

games.name: Yoshi's Crafted World
games.summary: Lead Yoshi on a brand new adventure that will turn everything you've come to expect from side-scrolling games upside down! Explore a great, big world decorated like a miniature diorama in a new art style for the franchise, where each side-scrolling stage has the traditional front side as well as a flip side with different views and surprises. Look for items throughout the stage as Yoshi makes his way to the goal. You can even join up with a friend!
games.description: A Yoshi platformer with a unique arts-and-crafts aesthetic where the world and all its inhabitants are made from cardboard, fabric, and paper. Explore side-scrolling courses from both sides to find hidden collectibles, solving puzzles using Yoshi's egg-throwing and flutter-jump mechanics.

games.name: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
games.summary: Suite directe du premier Zelda. Link doit réveiller la Princesse Zelda en collectant les 6 cristaux magiques. Gameplay en side-scrolling unique dans la série, avec des combats RPG.
games.description: The black sheep of the Zelda series — a side-scrolling action RPG sequel to the original Legend of Zelda. Link must restore the Triforce of Courage by placing crystals in six palaces across Hyrule. Features an experience point system, magic spells, and brutal combat that made it the most divisive Zelda ever made.

games.name: ZombiU
games.summary: For the second time in history, a great plague has enveloped London in a fog of death. Big Ben tolls as hundreds upon thousands of the unprepared die or are infected by a sickness worse than death...  You are still breathing for now, but how long will you survive in the labyrinth of London streets and underground? The horrifying remains of humanity ravaged by the foul disease shuffle through the streets waiting to prey on your living flesh at every turn!
games.description: Developed by Ubisoft Montpellier, the studio behind critically acclaimed titles like From Dust, Beyond Good & Evil and, Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter, ZombiU puts players in the middle of London circa 2012, where an outbreak has infected the population, destroying their humanity and turning them into mindless monsters preying on the flesh of the few remaining survivors. This fear-fueled first-person shooter invites takes all the horror, chaos and tension found in the best of the horror genre ...
